glossary.definition: An immutable or retained record of administrative, deletion, login, payment, or other auditable actions.
The catalog record describing a work or title and its associated volumes and Items.
A library facility or service point associated with a system or region.
A predefined Report with maintained fields, criteria, and execution behavior.
The set of check-in, checkout, renewal, hold, and related Item-use transactions.
A monetary charge assessed to a Patron account for a library-related obligation.
A Patron request to reserve or retrieve an Item or Bibliographic Record.
A configurable period since a Patron's last qualifying activity.
A physical library copy or material that can be cataloged, circulated, transferred, or deleted.
The structured machine-readable catalog metadata format used for Bibliographic Records.
A person with a library account who uses library services.
A saved or ad hoc set of criteria used to select records or produce a Report.
A generated presentation or export of selected library data and metrics.
The execution queue that tracks, prioritizes, and processes Reports.
A named security assignment that grants a defined set of permissions.
The physical or estimated capacity occupied by the library collection.
A library organization or consortium unit containing one or more Branches.
A reusable Report definition containing fields, criteria, formatting, and permissions.
A recorded operational, circulation, financial, or account event.
The movement state of an Item between sending and destination Branches.

requirements.name: Staff Badge Authentication
requirements.description: The system shall support staff authentication by either a mapped employee badge followed by the system's required individual authentication step or individual username and password. A badge shall identify exactly one enabled staff account and shall not by itself bypass authentication. Invalid, unassigned, or disabled badges shall not create a session, and acceptance shall verify that both methods identify and record the correct staff account at shared staff terminals.
requirements.priority_rationale: Secure staff authentication is essential to daily operation, and the sources explicitly require both badge identification and username-and-password access.

requirements.name: Staff Login Audit Logging
requirements.description: The system shall create an Audit Log entry whenever staff login is attempted or completed. Each entry shall identify the staff account, the time, the terminal or access point, and the authentication method, when available. The entries shall support review of which staff member was logged in for security and audit purposes.
requirements.priority_rationale: Recording staff identity and login context is an explicit audit need and is necessary to establish accountability for authenticated sessions.

requirements.name: Unattended Session Protection
requirements.description: The system shall provide controls that prevent or limit an authenticated staff session from remaining active on an unattended terminal. It shall provide a quick logout action and automatic session expiration after a configurable period of inactivity. When a session expires or is logged out, the terminal shall require staff authentication before protected functions can be used again.
requirements.priority_rationale: Preventing unattended authenticated terminals is an explicit security need for shared service computers and has no adequate operational workaround.

requirements.name: Quick Staff Session Switching
requirements.description: The system shall allow staff to switch the active authenticated account on a shared service terminal without restarting the application or performing unnecessary terminal setup. The current session shall be ended or protected before another staff member is authenticated. The feature shall support repeated switching among multiple staff members during the day while preserving each account's permissions and audit identity.
requirements.priority_rationale: Fast switching is clearly needed on shared terminals used by many staff, although a manual logout and login workaround exists.

requirements.name: Bibliographic Fields For Reporting
requirements.description: The system shall expose Bibliographic Record fields for reporting, including identifier, fingerprint, scan timestamp, record type, edition, language, ISBN, ISSN, UPC, EAN, publisher name, publication date, place of publication, and physical description. These fields shall be selectable or usable as Report criteria and output fields. Acceptance shall verify that each specified field can be retrieved for an applicable Bibliographic Record.
requirements.priority_rationale: The reporting reference explicitly requires access to these core Bibliographic Record fields.

requirements.name: Bibliographic Record Addition Report
requirements.description: The system shall provide a Report counting Bibliographic Records added during a selectable period. The Report shall support grouping by the staff member who added each record and by Branch. Acceptance shall verify that additions are attributed to the correct staff member and Branch.
requirements.priority_rationale: Multiple sources require addition counts by staff member and Branch to support contribution and workload analysis.

requirements.name: Bibliographic Record Count Report
requirements.description: The system shall provide a Report counting Bibliographic Records in the catalog. The Report shall be retained as a supported bibliographic Canned Report so stakeholders can monitor catalog size. Acceptance shall verify that the reported count matches the selected catalog population.
requirements.priority_rationale: Counting Bibliographic Records is a core, explicitly requested catalog reporting need and is supported by multiple sources.

requirements.name: Bibliographic Record Edit Report
requirements.description: The system shall provide a Report counting Bibliographic Records edited during a selectable period. The Report shall support grouping or filtering by the staff member who performed the edit when that information is available. Acceptance shall verify that records edited in the selected period are counted accurately.
requirements.priority_rationale: Multiple sources explicitly require edit counts to monitor cataloging activity and workload.

requirements.name: Bibliographic Records Without Items
requirements.description: The system shall provide a Report identifying Bibliographic Records with no associated volumes or Items. The Report shall support on-demand and periodic execution so staff can identify incomplete catalog relationships for corrective action. Acceptance shall verify that records without associated volumes or Items are included and records with such associations are excluded.
requirements.priority_rationale: Several sources explicitly request this quality-control Report to identify incomplete Bibliographic Records.

requirements.name: Catalog Data Quality Reports
requirements.description: The system shall provide data-quality Reports that identify catalog inconsistencies for corrective action. The Reports shall detect Items with invalid Item types, Items with call numbers exceeding the applicable length, and other underlying data problems identified by the data-quality configuration. Acceptance shall verify that each configured condition is detected accurately and that matching records are presented with sufficient identifying data for correction.
requirements.priority_rationale: Data-quality reporting is explicitly required to support catalog hygiene and corrective action across several concrete conditions.

requirements.name: Missing MARC Field Report
requirements.description: The system shall provide a Report identifying Bibliographic Records that lack specified MARC fields. The required fields shall be selectable so cataloging staff can check different metadata quality rules. Acceptance shall verify that records missing each selected field are included and records containing the field are excluded.
requirements.priority_rationale: Multiple sources explicitly require missing-field reporting for catalog quality control and cleanup.

requirements.name: Reportable Data Relationships
requirements.description: The system shall support reporting across key relationships between Bibliographic Records and Items, Items and Circulation actions, Patrons and Circulation actions, Patrons and money records, and staff actors and Circulation actions. These relationships shall permit related data to be joined without losing the source-record association. Acceptance shall verify representative cross-record Reports using each required relationship.
requirements.priority_rationale: Cross-record relationships are essential for producing meaningful bibliographic and operational Reports from the reporting data model.

requirements.name: Reportable Record Types
requirements.description: The system shall support reporting on Bibliographic Records, Items, Patrons, Circulation actions, Holds actions, money records, and staff actor records. Each listed record type shall be available as a reportable data source. Acceptance shall verify that a Report or Query can select records from every required type.
requirements.priority_rationale: The reporting reference explicitly identifies these core record types as necessary coverage for the reporting system.

requirements.name: Circulation Canned Reports
requirements.description: The system shall retain and support the specified Circulation Canned Reports for checkout counts, renewal counts, non-cataloged activity, and Circulation counts by shelving location. Each Canned Report shall remain executable with its maintained fields and criteria. Acceptance shall verify that all listed Canned Reports are available and produce the expected measures.
requirements.priority_rationale: The reference explicitly identifies these existing Canned Reports as supported reporting capabilities, although they are secondary to Bibliographic Record reporting in this topic.

requirements.name: Monthly Patron Addition Report
requirements.description: The system shall provide a Report showing the number of Patrons added for each month. The Report shall support a selectable reporting period so registration trends can be examined over time. Acceptance shall verify that each Patron is counted in the correct month based on the addition date.
requirements.priority_rationale: The report is explicitly requested but concerns a narrower analytical need than core Bibliographic Record reporting.

requirements.name: Patron Canned Reports
requirements.description: The system shall retain and support Canned Reports for total Patron counts and Patron counts by Branch. The Branch grouping shall use the Patron's associated home Branch. Acceptance shall verify both Report types and confirm that grouped counts reconcile with the total count.
requirements.priority_rationale: The reference explicitly requests these maintained Patron Reports, but they are less central to Bibliographic Reports than catalog data quality and count Reports.

requirements.name: Checkin Count Report
requirements.description: The system shall provide a Checkin Count Report showing the number of check-ins for the selected reporting period and scope. The Report shall use check-in transactions rather than renewal transactions. Acceptance shall verify that the resulting count matches the included check-in records.
requirements.priority_rationale: A dedicated check-in count is a core Circulation Report explicitly listed in the requirements.

requirements.name: Checkin Method Counts
requirements.description: The system shall count check-ins individually and cumulatively by method, including book-drop, terminal, and self-service check-ins. Reports shall allow staff to distinguish each method and view the combined check-in total. Acceptance shall verify both method-specific and cumulative counts.
requirements.priority_rationale: Method-level check-in analysis is explicitly requested in both the specification and staff survey.

requirements.name: Checkout Count Report
requirements.description: The system shall provide a Checkout Count Report that counts checkout transactions only. The Report shall exclude check-ins, Holds, and other transaction types from the checkout total. Acceptance shall verify the count against checkout records for the selected criteria.
requirements.priority_rationale: A checkout-only count is a core Circulation Report explicitly required by the specification.

requirements.name: Checkout Type Counts
requirements.description: The system shall count checkout transactions individually and cumulatively by type, including staff checkout, self-checkout, staff renewal, self-checkout renewal, online renewal, and OPAC renewal. Reports shall distinguish each type and provide a combined total. Acceptance shall verify that all listed types can be selected and counted separately.
requirements.priority_rationale: Detailed checkout and renewal type counts are explicitly required by both the specification and staff survey.

requirements.name: Circulation Counts By Type
requirements.description: The system shall provide total Circulation counts with separate counts for categorized, non-categorized, checkout, renewal, and non-cataloged transactions where applicable. The total shall combine category and non-category Circulation data without double-counting transactions. Reports shall display the component counts and the resulting total.
requirements.priority_rationale: Accurate total Circulation and its transaction-type breakdown are fundamental to circulation-volume reporting.

requirements.name: Core Circulation Activity Metrics
requirements.description: The system shall provide activity Reports containing checkouts, check-ins, Holds placed, and Holds filled. These metrics shall show Circulation traffic and volume of use for activity and board reporting. Each metric shall be independently identifiable and countable in the generated Report.
requirements.priority_rationale: The same four metrics are explicitly required across the specification, email, and survey and are central to Circulation analytics.

requirements.name: Distinct Checkin Timestamp
requirements.description: The system shall record and expose a check-in date and time that represents a physical check-in and does not include renewal events. Reports shall be able to filter and count transactions using this check-in timestamp. Acceptance shall verify that renewals do not alter check-in timestamp results.
requirements.priority_rationale: Separating check-ins from renewals is necessary for accurate check-in analytics and is explicitly confirmed by multiple sources.

requirements.name: Multi Scope Transaction Aggregates
requirements.description: The system shall generate transaction Reports for Holds placed, Holds filled, and checkouts at Patron, Branch, selected Branch-group, System, and county scopes. Reports shall provide counts for each requested scope and support Patron-level results where applicable. Hold results shall be subtotaled by Hold type, including active, frozen, and frozen-until Holds.
requirements.priority_rationale: Multi-level aggregation is explicitly required for operational and geographic Circulation analysis.

requirements.name: Overdue Item Reports
requirements.description: The system shall produce Reports listing Items overdue by a configurable number of days, including Items more than the specified threshold and Items marked longoverdue by the System. Reports shall support daily operations, shelf reading, and Patron follow-up, and shall include available Patron contact information for recovery actions. The system shall also provide a list of long-overdue Items without requiring a separate workflow.
requirements.priority_rationale: Overdue reporting is repeatedly requested for daily operations, shelf reading, and Patron contact.

requirements.name: Renewals Count Report
requirements.description: The system shall provide a Renewals Count Report showing the number of renewal transactions for selected reporting criteria. Renewal counts shall be distinguishable from checkout and check-in counts. Acceptance shall verify the result against renewal transaction records.
requirements.priority_rationale: Renewals are a core Circulation transaction and are explicitly required as a dedicated count.

requirements.name: Circulation By Patron County
requirements.description: The system shall provide Circulation counts by circulation Branch or location further broken down by Patron county. Reports shall show the count for each county within each selected circulation location. Acceptance shall verify that the breakdown reflects the Patron county associated with each qualifying transaction.
requirements.priority_rationale: Geographic usage analysis is explicitly requested in multiple sources but is less essential than core Circulation metrics.

requirements.name: Circulation By Patron Home Branch
requirements.description: The system shall provide Circulation counts by circulation location broken down by the Patron's home Branch. Reports shall show counts for each home Branch within each selected circulation location. Acceptance shall verify that the grouping uses the Patron home Branch stored for the transaction's Patron.
requirements.priority_rationale: Home-Branch comparison is explicitly required for analyzing where Patrons circulate Items, though it is a specialized dimension.

requirements.name: Circulation Counts By Dewey
requirements.description: The system shall provide Reports counting Circulation by Dewey classification. Staff shall be able to analyze usage for individual classifications or selected Dewey classification ranges. Acceptance shall verify that counts are grouped according to the Items' Dewey values.
requirements.priority_rationale: Dewey-based usage analysis is explicitly requested but is a specialized analytical dimension.

requirements.name: Circulation Counts By MARC
requirements.description: The system shall provide Circulation Reports grouped or filtered by MARC fields associated with the relevant Bibliographic Record or Item. Staff shall be able to associate usage counts with selected catalog metadata. Acceptance shall verify that a selected MARC field or value produces the corresponding Circulation counts.
requirements.priority_rationale: MARC-based usage analysis is explicitly requested for metadata-related analysis but is not a core transaction function.

requirements.name: Circulation Counts By Shelf Location
requirements.description: The system shall provide Circulation counts grouped by shelving location. Reports shall identify the shelving location associated with the circulated Item and show its corresponding count. Acceptance shall verify counts for selected shelving locations and reporting criteria.
requirements.priority_rationale: Shelving-location usage supports collection and service analysis but is not required for basic transaction totals.

requirements.name: Circulation Modifier Category Counts
requirements.description: The system shall provide Circulation counts grouped by circulation modifier and category fields such as Cat1 and Cat2. Reports shall support values including Adult, YA, and Juv when those values exist in the data. Acceptance shall verify counts for each selected modifier and category combination.
requirements.priority_rationale: Modifier and category analysis is explicitly requested, but it is more specialized than core transaction totals.

requirements.name: Claims Returned Report
requirements.description: The system shall provide a Claims Returned Report listing Items associated with Patron claims that the Items were returned. The Report shall support selection of qualifying claims and display the associated Item information. Acceptance shall verify that claimed-return Items appear and unrelated Items do not.
requirements.priority_rationale: A Claims Returned Report is explicitly requested for circulation follow-up and appears in both the specification and reference material.

requirements.name: Date-Based Item Use Counts
requirements.description: The system shall provide total use counts for Items and usage counts broken down by selected date ranges. Supported ranges shall include fiscal-year and monthly periods. Acceptance shall verify that the total and each date-range count reflect qualifying use transactions within the specified dates.
requirements.priority_rationale: Time-based use analysis is explicitly requested and supports routine circulation trend reporting.

requirements.name: Hold Placement Methods
requirements.description: The system shall count Holds and report how each Hold was placed, including at a staff desk, at a public computer inside a Branch, or remotely. Reports shall support both method-specific counts and identification of the placement method for each qualifying Hold. Acceptance shall verify that Holds placed through each listed method are correctly classified.
requirements.priority_rationale: Hold placement analysis is explicitly requested in both the specification and staff survey, but is less central than basic Circulation totals.

requirements.name: Include Uncataloged Circulation
requirements.description: The system shall count Transactions involving uncataloged Items and include them in overall Circulation statistics and Reports. The resulting totals shall reflect usage alongside Transactions involving cataloged Items. Reports shall also identify the portion attributable to uncataloged Items so staff can analyze that activity without completed Bibliographic Records.
requirements.priority_rationale: Complete Circulation reporting requires uncataloged Transactions, although manual reconciliation can temporarily compensate for its absence.

requirements.name: Item Use Count Filtering
requirements.description: The system shall provide Reports listing Items whose total use count meets a specified threshold or matches a specified total use count. Staff shall be able to use the resulting list for Circulation analysis. Acceptance shall verify correct inclusion and exclusion of Items at, above, and below the selected count criteria.
requirements.priority_rationale: Use-count filtering is explicitly requested in the specification and reference material for circulation analysis.

requirements.name: Last Circulation Date
requirements.description: The system shall provide a separate last circulation date field for each applicable Item. Reports shall use this field to identify the most recent Circulation independently from other dates. Acceptance shall verify that the field records and displays the latest qualifying circulation date.
requirements.priority_rationale: A separate last-circulation value is explicitly requested to support accurate use and circulation reporting.

requirements.name: Transaction Dimension Grouping
requirements.description: The system shall allow transaction Reports and Queries to group results by hour, terminal, Branch, and System. Reporting shall support all transactions or a selected transaction type, including check-ins, checkouts, fines collected, and Patron registrations where those transaction records are available. Acceptance shall verify that each dimension produces separate counts and that transaction-type selection limits the results correctly.
requirements.priority_rationale: Dimension-based transaction analysis is explicitly requested by the survey and specification for workload and trend analysis.

requirements.name: Items By Fines Stopped Reason
requirements.description: The system shall provide a Report listing Items associated with a selected fines-stopped reason. Staff shall be able to review the associated Item and reason information for circulation follow-up and auditing. Acceptance shall verify that only Items with the selected reason are included.
requirements.priority_rationale: The report is explicitly requested but supports a specialized fine-handling workflow rather than core circulation analytics.

requirements.name: All Branch Capacity Overview
requirements.description: The system shall provide a high-level Report or dashboard showing capacity and inventory metrics for all Branches in a System. The view shall aggregate centralized capacity data across Branches and present the Branches together for at-a-glance resource allocation and collection planning. Acceptance shall verify that a user can view all Branches in one system-wide overview and that the displayed aggregate values match the centralized source data.
requirements.priority_rationale: Multiple sources identify system-wide capacity visibility as essential for daily monitoring and resource allocation.

requirements.name: Break Down Collection Categories
requirements.description: The system shall break down collection volume by cataloged genre and format classifications, such as adult fiction and board books. Reports shall support grouping and aggregation by these category fields. The category values shall be taken from the existing catalog metadata used for the collection.
requirements.priority_rationale: Category composition is explicitly required to understand and manage collection capacity by genre and format.

requirements.name: Cross-Branch Capacity Access
requirements.description: The system shall allow Branch managers and other authorized Roles to view capacity information for Branches beyond their home Branch. Access shall be governed by the applicable Role permissions rather than by an unconditional restriction to the manager's home Branch. Unauthorized Roles shall not gain access through this capability.
requirements.priority_rationale: Cross-Branch visibility is explicitly required for allocation decisions and must be controlled to remain appropriate for each Role.

requirements.name: Define Capacity Metrics
requirements.description: The system shall define and identify the capacity metrics used in Reports, such as Item counts, Shelf Space, configured limits, or other agreed measures. Each displayed metric shall have a precise meaning and distinguish physical collection volume from operational capacity where applicable. Users shall be able to determine which metric is represented in an overview or Report.
requirements.priority_rationale: Unambiguous capacity definitions are essential for interpreting all capacity Reports and avoiding inconsistent decisions.

requirements.name: Drill Into Branch Capacity
requirements.description: The system shall allow users to select a Branch from a capacity overview and view its detailed capacity information. Branch detail shall select Items using the Branch or Item location associated with that Branch. The detail view shall provide the supporting metrics needed to understand the selected Branch's collection volume.
requirements.priority_rationale: Branch-level detail is necessary for staff to act on the system-wide capacity information.

requirements.name: Estimate Shelf Space
requirements.description: The system shall estimate Shelf Space when direct Shelf Space data is unavailable. It shall use available Item dimensions when present and an Item-count proxy when dimensions are missing, while allowing authorized administrators to configure or tune the fallback estimation method. Reports shall identify or consistently apply the selected estimation basis and make the resulting values available for capacity analysis.
requirements.priority_rationale: Shelf Space analysis cannot be implemented reliably because the source data does not directly track Shelf Space.

requirements.name: Material Volume Report
requirements.description: The system shall generate a Material Volume Report for a selected Branch or System as of a specified point in time. The Report shall provide category and total counts, including new acquisitions, Items currently on the shelf, and Items currently checked out, with checked-out Items included in the total. Users shall be able to apply the relevant acquisition time selection, and results shall be reproducible for governance, board reporting, collection management, and quarterly assessment.
requirements.priority_rationale: A dated volume Report with collection breakdowns is explicitly identified as a key governance and collection-management requirement.

requirements.name: Shelf Space Comparison Report
requirements.description: The system shall provide a Shelf Space Report that compares, for each selected genre and format, the percentage of total Circulation, the percentage of the collection, and the percentage of total Shelf Space. The Report shall calculate collection percentages from Item counts and Circulation percentages from checkout totals for the selected scope and date range. It shall support Branch-level and System-level results so staff can compare local and aggregated collection allocation. The presentation shall support identifying mismatches between space and use.
requirements.priority_rationale: This comparison is requested repeatedly by the working group and directly supports collection allocation and physical shelving decisions.

requirements.name: Branch Comparison View
requirements.description: The system shall provide a comparison view that displays the capacity or collection breakdown for multiple Branches side by side. The view shall use a multi-column or matrix presentation that enables users to compare Branch results and identify outliers. The compared metrics shall correspond to the selected Report and scope.
requirements.priority_rationale: Side-by-side comparison is an important analysis aid for spotting differences between Branches, with a workable alternative of reviewing Branches separately.

requirements.name: Capacity Trend Reporting
requirements.description: The system shall provide Reports or views showing changes in Branch capacity over time. Results shall support historical comparison or time-series analysis so staff can determine whether capacity is growing or shrinking. The selected time range and comparison points shall be identifiable in the output.
requirements.priority_rationale: Trend analysis is explicitly requested for long-term planning, although current capacity reporting can operate without it.

requirements.name: Collection Volume Trend Reporting
requirements.description: The system shall provide Reports or views showing changes in collection volume over time. Staff shall be able to use historical comparisons or time series to analyze changes in collection size. The output shall identify the time periods represented so that volume changes can be verified.
requirements.priority_rationale: Historical collection-size analysis is requested for trend planning but is not required to produce a current volume count.

requirements.name: Compare Branch Capacity
requirements.description: The system shall provide Reports that compare capacity and collection metrics across multiple Branches. A selected Branch shall be comparable with the System average for the same genre or format where those dimensions are reported. The comparison shall support analysis of local collection conditions against peer and system-wide results.
requirements.priority_rationale: Branch-to-system and cross-Branch comparison is a clear management need, but Branch detail alone provides a temporary alternative.

requirements.name: Configurable Aggregation Levels
requirements.description: The system shall allow Reports to aggregate and present collection and capacity results at configurable organisational levels. Supported levels shall include at least Branch and System, and the configuration shall accommodate additional levels such as Home Library or County when those dimensions exist in the data. The selected grouping shall be reflected in the Report results.
requirements.priority_rationale: Multiple sources require results at different organisational levels, while a fixed set of levels provides a temporary workaround.

requirements.name: Consolidated Volume Report
requirements.description: The system shall provide a single consolidated Report that combines the volume counts needed from the multiple existing screens used by staff. The Report shall eliminate the need to collect and reconcile those counts manually across separate interfaces. Its output shall be available as one coherent result for the selected reporting scope.
requirements.priority_rationale: The request addresses a significant recurring manual effort, but existing screens provide a temporary workaround.

requirements.name: Export Capacity Data
requirements.description: The system shall allow users to export selected or filtered capacity data to common spreadsheet formats, including CSV. The export shall contain the capacity values represented by the selected view or Report. Users shall be able to use the exported data for spreadsheet analysis and director-level Reports.
requirements.priority_rationale: Multiple stakeholders need spreadsheet-based analysis, although viewing capacity within the system provides a temporary alternative.

requirements.name: Filter Acquisition Date Ranges
requirements.description: The system shall allow users to filter new acquisitions by a date range. It shall provide common presets such as the last 30, 60, and 90 days. The resulting Report shall show the volume acquired within the selected range.
requirements.priority_rationale: Standard acquisition windows are specifically requested and provide useful recurring capacity insight, although custom calculations remain possible without presets.

requirements.name: Filter Branch Capacity
requirements.description: The system shall allow users to filter Branch capacity results by available Branch attributes, including region, Branch type, and current load. Filtering shall limit the overview or Report to Branches matching the selected values. The resulting subset shall retain its capacity metrics.
requirements.priority_rationale: Stakeholders explicitly requested attribute-based filtering to focus capacity analysis on relevant Branch subsets.

requirements.name: Filter Reports By Date
requirements.description: The system shall allow users to filter applicable collection and Shelf Space Reports by arbitrary date ranges, such as months, quarters, or other start and end dates. Users shall be able to compare results for different periods, including seasonal or quarterly comparisons. The selected date range shall be visible or otherwise identifiable in the Report.
requirements.priority_rationale: Quarterly and period-based analysis is explicitly needed for capacity review, though current snapshots remain a usable fallback.

requirements.name: Group Branch Capacity
requirements.description: The system shall allow users to group Branch capacity results by System, region, or another configured logical grouping. Grouped results shall present aggregated capacity values for each group. The grouping shall reduce the need to inspect individual Branches when analyzing larger collections.
requirements.priority_rationale: Grouping is an important usability improvement for reviewing capacity across many Branches, but individual Branch results remain a workaround.

requirements.name: Report Holds By Category
requirements.description: The system shall report the number of Holds for a selected Branch or System. It shall also break Hold counts down by the same collection categories used for volume analysis where category data is available. The Report shall present Hold pressure alongside Item counts so staff can compare demand with collection composition.
requirements.priority_rationale: Hold pressure by category supports collection capacity decisions, but a temporary overall Hold count can provide limited insight.

requirements.name: Show Historical Volume
requirements.description: The system shall allow users to request collection volume as of a specified historical date rather than only the current snapshot. The calculation shall use available acquisition and Item status data to represent the volume at that point in time. The selected as-of date shall be identifiable in the resulting Report.
requirements.priority_rationale: Historical snapshots are explicitly requested for analysis, although current volume reporting is the essential baseline.

requirements.name: Sortable Capacity Results
requirements.description: The system shall allow users to sort the Branch capacity list or table by available fields such as Branch name, capacity metric, or load. Sorting shall update the displayed results without changing the underlying data. The available sort fields shall be identifiable in the interface.
requirements.priority_rationale: Sorting is explicitly requested to support routine analysis, although users can temporarily review an unsorted list.

requirements.name: Color-Coded Capacity Indicators
requirements.description: The system shall display capacity status indicators using distinguishable colors for under-capacity, approaching-full, and at-or-over-capacity states. The interface shall use green for under capacity, yellow for getting full, and red for at or over capacity, or provide an equivalent accessible status indication. The status shall be derived from the configured capacity thresholds.
requirements.priority_rationale: Color coding improves rapid interpretation but is a desirable presentation enhancement rather than a prerequisite for capacity reporting.

requirements.name: Customizable Volume Categories
requirements.description: The system shall allow authorized staff to define and customize the categories and category groupings used in a volume breakdown. The selected categories shall be applied consistently when generating the relevant Material Volume Report. This shall allow different Branches or Systems to use their preferred classification sets.
requirements.priority_rationale: Custom classification supports differing library practices but is requested by fewer sources and is not necessary for basic volume reporting.

requirements.name: List Checked-Out Items
requirements.description: The system shall produce a list of Items currently checked out for the selected Branch or applicable collection scope. The list shall identify the checked-out Items that contribute to the reported collection volume. Users shall be able to use the list to inspect the checked-out component of capacity.
requirements.priority_rationale: An Item-level checked-out list is useful for investigation, but aggregate checked-out counts satisfy the core capacity need.

requirements.name: Aggregate Deletion Counts
requirements.description: The system shall produce deletion counts aggregated by Branch and by System. Reports shall support filtering or aggregation by date range, person or process responsible for the deletion, and record type. Users shall be able to obtain total deletion counts for configurable periods such as a month, quarter, or year. The reporting capability shall include the number of deleted Items.
requirements.priority_rationale: Multiple sources require location-level, system-wide, period-based, and record-type deletion counts for routine oversight.

requirements.name: Capture Deletion Audit Events
requirements.description: The system shall record deletion events for Items, Patrons, Bibliographic Records, and other deleted record types. Each event shall identify the record type, record identifier, person or process that performed the deletion, deletion timestamp, and Branch or other location context. Where available, the event shall also capture the pre-deletion status and the deletion reason. These records shall allow staff to investigate accidental deletions and establish who deleted what, when, and where.
requirements.priority_rationale: Deletion traceability is explicitly required by multiple sources and is essential for auditing and accountability.

requirements.name: Query Deleted Record Audit
requirements.description: The system shall provide a Report interface for viewing, filtering, and retrieving deletion audit events. Staff shall be able to list deleted records by record type and period, including all records of a selected type deleted during a specified quarter or other date range. The resulting audit evidence shall provide authoritative records and counts that can be used to demonstrate compliance with retention schedules.
requirements.priority_rationale: Audit and compliance users need direct access to detailed deletion evidence, and this need is explicitly identified as important.

requirements.name: Filter Transaction Audit Reports
requirements.description: The system shall provide audit Reports for deletion-related transactions filtered by exact date and time, workstation, or staff member. Users shall be able to apply each criterion individually and in combination where corresponding audit data exists. The results shall support detailed auditing and troubleshooting of the selected transactions.
requirements.priority_rationale: Detailed transaction filtering improves audit investigations but is less central than capturing and retaining deletion events.

requirements.name: Log Denied Deletion Attempts
requirements.description: The system shall record deletion attempts that are denied because of authorization failures or other system controls. Each denied attempt shall identify the attempted record when available, the actor, timestamp, location, and denial outcome. Administrators shall be able to use these records to detect repeated or inappropriate deletion attempts.
requirements.priority_rationale: Denied-attempt auditing supports security monitoring and is explicitly requested, but the system can operate with a temporary monitoring workaround.

requirements.name: Rank Deleting Staff
requirements.description: The system shall provide a Report that ranks staff or other deletion actors by the number of deletion events attributed to them. The ranking shall be based on a selectable reporting period and the captured deletion audit events. Administrators shall be able to use the result to identify unusually high deletion activity for investigation.
requirements.priority_rationale: Ranking deletion actors is a useful monitoring enhancement requested by one source but is not essential to basic deletion auditing.

requirements.name: Integrated Searchable Help
requirements.description: The system shall provide an online HTML help system integrated with the reporting interface. The help system shall be hierarchical, cross-linked, searchable, easy to navigate, and include context-sensitive guidance where appropriate. It shall describe and illustrate system functions so staff can obtain documentation without leaving the relevant interface or contacting IT for routine assistance.
requirements.priority_rationale: Multiple sources explicitly require integrated online help, including high-priority requests for comprehensive assistance during routine reporting work.

requirements.name: Administrative Error Feedback
requirements.description: The system shall provide meaningful high-level error reports and feedback through the front-end interface. For report or Query failures, it shall provide Local and Global System Administrators with low-level, Query-specific diagnostic details, including the affected table, field, and type of error when available. The feedback shall enable administrators to diagnose and correct failures without relying solely on developers.
requirements.priority_rationale: Detailed error feedback is requested by multiple sources and materially improves administration, although manual developer diagnosis provides a temporary workaround.

requirements.name: Associate Financial Transactions
requirements.description: The system shall associate Fines, charges, waivers, and e-commerce Transactions with the relevant Patron and Item records. These associations shall be available for account review, reporting, reconciliation, and audit. A financial Transaction shall remain identifiable through the records to which it applies.
requirements.priority_rationale: Associating financial events with Patron and Item records is necessary for accurate balances, reporting, and reconciliation.

requirements.name: Core Financial Reports
requirements.description: The system shall provide and maintain financial Reports for Bills Currently Owed by Patrons, Detailed Payments Received, and Aged Debt. The payments Report shall show transaction-level detail for reconciliation, and the Aged Debt Report shall show overdue balances using aging buckets with sufficient detail for collection activity. The Reports shall remain available as supported financial reporting functions.
requirements.priority_rationale: These financial Reports are explicitly identified as established core outputs for billing, reconciliation, and collections.

requirements.name: Maintain Payment Ledger
requirements.description: The system shall maintain a detailed ledger of Patron payments. Each payment shall identify the specific Fine or charge to which it was applied, allowing staff to trace payment activity for reconciliation and audit. The ledger shall retain transaction-level details needed to explain account balances.
requirements.priority_rationale: The working-group requirement marks payment traceability as critical to reconciliation and auditing.

requirements.name: Query High-Balance Accounts
requirements.description: The system shall allow authorized staff to query and list Patron accounts whose balance exceeds a specified dollar threshold. The threshold shall be supplied by staff or configured as an operational value. The query and user interface shall allow staff to find qualifying accounts promptly, avoiding a slow manual process, and shall identify accounts requiring collection or account-management attention.
requirements.priority_rationale: Identifying accounts over a balance threshold is an explicit operational need for collection activity, and prompt access is needed to replace the current slow manual process.

requirements.name: Report Fines By Period
requirements.description: The system shall provide Reports of Fines and charges accrued during a selectable time period. Staff shall be able to group or filter results by charge type, including overdue, damaged Item, and lost Item charges. Supported periods shall include configurable date ranges and common periods such as the previous twelve months, year to date, and the previous month.
requirements.priority_rationale: Fines and charge reporting is a core financial reporting need explicitly requested by multiple sources.

requirements.name: Report Patron Account Balances
requirements.description: The system shall provide Reports of Patron account balances at individual Patron, Branch, and System levels. Staff shall be able to determine the balance associated with each Patron and aggregate balances for a Branch or the entire System. The Report shall identify the reporting scope used for each result.
requirements.priority_rationale: Balance reporting is a core financial-account function requested by multiple sources.

requirements.name: Report Payments By Method
requirements.description: The system shall provide Reports of payments received during a selectable time period. Results shall be broken down by payment method or channel, including cash, credit card, check, staff desk, self-check station, and OPAC where recorded, and shall support Branch-level reporting. These breakdowns shall support daily, monthly, and end-of-month reconciliation.
requirements.priority_rationale: Payment reporting by time, method, and Branch is important for routine reconciliation and is explicitly marked important by stakeholders.

requirements.name: Track Financial Transactions
requirements.description: The system shall record and provide verification of financial Transactions related to library operations. Staff shall be able to use the recorded transactions to support accounting, reconciliation, and auditing. The system shall preserve sufficient transaction details to verify each financial event.
requirements.priority_rationale: Accurate transaction tracking is essential to all financial reporting, reconciliation, and audit activities.

requirements.name: Join Financial Data Sources
requirements.description: The system shall allow financial Queries and Reports to combine data associated with Patron records and Item records. Staff shall be able to use relationships between the two data sources to produce cross-referenced financial results. The combined results shall preserve the identifying context of both the Patron and Item.
requirements.priority_rationale: Cross-referencing Patron and Item financial data enables important reports that cannot be produced from either source alone.

requirements.name: Provide Director Financial Reporting
requirements.description: The system shall provide financial Reports suitable for director-level review. Directors shall be able to review financial summaries and supporting details within their authorized scope. The Reports shall cover relevant account, Fine, payment, waiver, and balance information without requiring manual compilation.
requirements.priority_rationale: Director-level financial review is an explicit stakeholder need, but it can initially rely on the underlying operational Reports.

requirements.name: Report Historical Bill Snapshots
requirements.description: The system shall provide a historical snapshot Report for Patron bills. Authorized staff shall be able to review the state of bills at selected points in the past. The snapshots shall support audit, dispute investigation, and historical financial reporting.
requirements.priority_rationale: Historical bill states support auditing and dispute resolution and are requested by multiple sources, though they are not required for every daily transaction.

requirements.name: Report Item Monetary Values
requirements.description: The system shall generate Reports of Item monetary values using the purchase price or equivalent value stored in Item records. Staff shall be able to report on the entire collection or a selectable subset filtered by attributes such as status, format, collection, call number, or shelving location. The system shall query and aggregate the values to produce totals and summaries.
requirements.priority_rationale: Item valuation supports collection financial analysis and is requested in several sources, but it is less central than account and payment processing.

requirements.name: Report Voided Transactions
requirements.description: The system shall provide a Report of voided financial Transactions. Each result shall include sufficient transaction detail to support audit and financial control review. Authorized staff shall be able to identify when and what financial activity was voided.
requirements.priority_rationale: Voided-transaction reporting supports financial control and auditability, although it is narrower than routine payment reporting.

requirements.name: Report Waived Fines
requirements.description: The system shall track and report Fines waived during a selectable time period. Staff shall be able to view waiver results by Branch so that each Branch can monitor its waiver activity and budget. The Report shall identify the applicable period and Branch for each aggregate.
requirements.priority_rationale: Branch-level waiver reporting supports budget control and is explicitly requested by several financial sources.

requirements.name: Report Alternative Payments
requirements.description: The system shall provide a detailed Report of alternative payment and adjustment types, including forgive, work, and goods payments. The Report shall identify each relevant Transaction and its amount or adjustment. Staff shall be able to use the results to track these nonstandard payment types.
requirements.priority_rationale: Alternative payment reporting is useful for specialized reconciliation but is requested by only one source.

requirements.name: Stale Holds Report
requirements.description: The system shall provide a Report identifying Holds that have remained on the Hold shelf awaiting Patron pickup beyond a configured acceptable period. The Report shall identify the Holds requiring cleanup or staff intervention. Staff shall be able to use the Report to support purging or follow-up actions.
requirements.priority_rationale: Two sources request this capability and stale Holds require timely operational action to keep fulfillment processes accurate.

requirements.name: Unfilled Holds Report
requirements.description: The system shall produce a Report identifying Holds that remain unfilled. The Report shall provide the information needed by acquisitions and operational staff to investigate unmet Patron demand and fulfillment backlogs. Staff shall be able to use the Report for follow-up and demand planning.
requirements.priority_rationale: Two sources explicitly request this report and unfilled Holds directly affect Patron service and acquisition decisions.

requirements.name: Annual Holds Placed Count
requirements.description: The system shall provide an annual count of Holds placed. The count shall be calculated for a specified year and shall be available in a Report. Staff shall be able to use the result for Hold trend analysis and planning.
requirements.priority_rationale: Annual Hold volume is an explicitly requested planning metric, but manual aggregation of transaction data provides a temporary workaround.

requirements.name: Bibliographic Records With Holds
requirements.description: The system shall generate a periodic Report listing Bibliographic Records with one or more active Holds. The Report shall identify the affected Bibliographic Records and the associated Hold presence so staff can monitor demand. The Report shall support recurring or on-demand execution according to the system's reporting capabilities.
requirements.priority_rationale: This is a clearly requested operational report that supports monitoring demand, although staff have temporary alternatives through existing Hold searches.

requirements.name: Holds Purchase Alert
requirements.description: The system shall provide a Report identifying demand-driven opportunities to purchase additional copies or titles based on Holds. The Report shall identify Holds or demand patterns that indicate existing supply may be insufficient. Acquisitions staff shall be able to use the Report to evaluate potential purchases.
requirements.priority_rationale: Two source documents request this capability because it supports purchasing decisions, but purchasing can continue temporarily through manual demand review.

requirements.name: IntraPINES Loan Reporting
requirements.description: The system shall provide Reports of IntraPINES loans across Systems and Branches. Users shall be able to view the loans at overall, System-grouped, and Branch-grouped levels. The Reports shall support monitoring inter-System and inter-Branch lending activity and related metrics.
requirements.priority_rationale: Multiple candidates request these reporting scopes, indicating broad stakeholder interest, although lending activity can temporarily be monitored through lower-level transaction data.

requirements.name: Item-Level Holds Report
requirements.description: The system shall provide a periodic Report of Holds placed on specific Items. The Report shall distinguish Item-level Holds from Holds placed only at the Bibliographic Record level. Staff shall be able to use the Report to monitor and manage Item-specific fulfillment activity.
requirements.priority_rationale: Item-level Hold visibility is an explicitly requested operational need that supports fulfillment, though some manual Hold review may be possible as a workaround.

requirements.name: Items Received For Holds
requirements.description: The system shall provide a Report listing Items received to satisfy Holds. The Report shall identify the received Items and their associated Hold fulfillment activity. Staff shall be able to use the Report to reconcile receipt and completion of Hold fulfillment.
requirements.priority_rationale: This operational reconciliation report is explicitly requested and supports fulfillment tracking, although staff may temporarily reconcile receipts manually.

requirements.name: Items Sent For Holds
requirements.description: The system shall provide a Report listing Items sent to fulfill Holds. The Report shall support identification of the sending Branch and the relevant destination or supplier activity when that information is available. Staff shall be able to use the Report to track Hold-related Item movement and reconcile fulfillment.
requirements.priority_rationale: Tracking Items sent for Holds is explicitly requested and supports fulfillment reconciliation, but staff can temporarily use transaction or Transit records.

requirements.name: Items Without Recent Checkouts
requirements.description: The system shall generate a periodic Report listing Items that have not been checked out during a configurable number of days. Staff shall be able to specify the value of X days used to identify qualifying Items. The Report shall present the resulting Items for collection review or operational follow-up.
requirements.priority_rationale: This report supports collection and operational decisions and is explicitly requested, but staff can temporarily identify such Items through other circulation analysis.

requirements.name: Missing Items Report
requirements.description: The system shall provide a periodic Report of Items marked or otherwise recorded as missing. The Report shall identify the affected Items and their relevant catalog or Branch information when available. Staff shall be able to use the Report for investigation and operational follow-up.
requirements.priority_rationale: Periodic visibility of missing Items is explicitly requested and supports operations, but staff may temporarily obtain the information through Item-status searches.

requirements.name: Item Activity Reports
requirements.description: The system shall provide separate Reports for Items added, Items edited, total Item counts, and lists of Items added within a selectable date range. Each Report shall present the applicable count or Item list using the selected reporting period and available identifying fields. Acceptance shall verify count accuracy, date-range inclusion for added Items, and correct identification of edited Items.
requirements.priority_rationale: Multiple sources explicitly request Item counts and cataloging activity Reports for operational monitoring.

requirements.name: Periodic Last Item Report
requirements.description: The system shall provide a periodic Report identifying each Bibliographic Record whose title has exactly one remaining Item in the System. The Report shall support recurring execution and include sufficient identifying metadata and holdings information for catalogers to avoid accidental deletion and update external catalog records. Acceptance shall verify that titles with exactly one remaining Item are included and titles with multiple Items are excluded.
requirements.priority_rationale: The working-group sources identify last-Item reporting as critical for preventing accidental deletion and supporting catalog maintenance.

requirements.name: Standard Item Canned Reports
requirements.description: The system shall maintain Canned Reports for Items added, Items deleted, Items currently checked out, Items overdue by a specified number of days, and Items with missing status. Each Canned Report shall retain its supported fields and execution behavior for staff use. Acceptance shall verify that all listed Canned Reports are available and return records matching their defined conditions.
requirements.priority_rationale: The maintained standard Item Reports are explicitly identified as required operational reporting capabilities.

requirements.name: Weeding Reports With Use History
requirements.description: The system shall provide weeding Reports that help staff identify Items for retention or withdrawal decisions. Each applicable result shall include the date of last Circulation and the number of Circulations for the Item. Acceptance shall verify that staff can use the Report to review Items and that both use-history fields are populated accurately.
requirements.priority_rationale: The sources describe weeding Reports as frequently used and specifically require last-Circulation information for collection decisions.

requirements.name: Collection Age By Location
requirements.description: The system shall provide a Report of collection age metrics grouped by call number or shelving location. Staff shall be able to use the results to assess the age of different collection segments. Acceptance shall verify that age values are calculated from Item or collection dates and are grouped under the requested call-number or shelving-location dimension.
requirements.priority_rationale: Two sources request collection-age analysis to support collection management and assessment.

requirements.name: Configurable Weeding Criteria
requirements.description: The system shall allow staff to identify Items for weeding using configurable criteria. Criteria shall support conditions such as Missing status for more than a specified number of months and an explicit discard or weed status. Acceptance shall verify that staff can configure the criteria and that the resulting Report includes only Items satisfying them.
requirements.priority_rationale: Configurable criteria are explicitly requested to support different local collection-management practices.

requirements.name: Item Last Edit Date
requirements.description: The system shall provide an Item last-edit-date field in Reports that represents the most recent metadata edit. Circulation Transactions shall not update or be treated as Item edits for this field. Acceptance shall verify that editing an Item changes the field while a subsequent Circulation Transaction does not.
requirements.priority_rationale: Two sources require a reliable distinction between catalog editing and Circulation activity for report interpretation.

requirements.name: Items By Bibliographic Content
requirements.description: The system shall provide a Report listing Items whose associated Bibliographic Record contains a specified string or field value. Staff shall be able to specify the content to match, such as a designated marker in the record. Acceptance shall verify that matching Items are returned and nonmatching Bibliographic Records are excluded.
requirements.priority_rationale: Content-based Item selection supports catalog quality work but is less central than standard status and date reports.

requirements.name: Items By Creation Date
requirements.description: The system shall provide Reports listing Items created within a specified creation-date range. Staff shall be able to enter or select the start and end dates for monitoring acquisitions and processing. Acceptance shall verify that Items inside the inclusive range are returned and Items outside it are excluded.
requirements.priority_rationale: Two sources request this report for acquisitions and processing monitoring, indicating a recurring operational need.

requirements.name: Low Use Weeding Report
requirements.description: The system shall provide a weeding Report listing Items whose total use count is below a specified threshold. Staff shall be able to provide or select the threshold used for the Report. Acceptance shall verify that Items below the threshold are included and Items at or above it are excluded.
requirements.priority_rationale: Low-use identification is a direct and practical basis for collection weeding decisions.

requirements.name: Missing Item Report
requirements.description: The system shall provide a Report listing Items whose status is Missing. The Report shall identify each matching Item and its relevant catalog or Branch information. Acceptance shall verify that Items with Missing status are included and Items with other statuses are excluded.
requirements.priority_rationale: Identifying Missing Items is a common collection-control need, although detailed missing-pattern analysis is separate.

requirements.name: Periodic Invalid Item Reports
requirements.description: The system shall provide a periodic Report identifying Items whose Item type is invalid. The Report shall identify each matching Item sufficiently for staff to locate and correct the data. Acceptance shall verify that invalid Item types are included, valid Item types are excluded, and the Report can execute on its configured periodic schedule.
requirements.priority_rationale: This targeted catalog-quality Report supports correction work but is less central than core circulation and Item reporting.

requirements.name: Invalid Patron Home Branch Report
requirements.description: The system shall provide a periodic Report identifying Patrons whose home Branch value is invalid. The Report shall identify the affected Patron account and the invalid value for correction. Acceptance shall verify that invalid home-Branch references are included and valid references are excluded.
requirements.priority_rationale: This is a useful data-quality report but is outside the core Item and catalog reporting workload.

requirements.name: Missing Patterns By Shelf
requirements.description: The system shall provide Reports that aggregate missing or damaged Items by shelf or shelving location over time. Staff shall be able to examine recurring patterns, such as repeated losses from the same shelf, to inform collection-placement decisions. Acceptance shall verify aggregation by the selected shelf dimension and across a specified time period.
requirements.priority_rationale: Pattern analysis can improve collection decisions but is a specialized enhancement beyond basic Missing Item reporting.

requirements.name: Periodic Long Call Number Reports
requirements.description: The system shall provide a periodic Report identifying Items whose call number exceeds the configured or supported length. The Report shall show the affected Item and its call number for catalog review. Acceptance shall verify that Items above the applicable length are included, shorter call numbers are excluded, and the Report executes on its configured periodic schedule.
requirements.priority_rationale: Long call-number detection is useful for catalog maintenance but has limited impact compared with core Item and collection Reports.

requirements.name: Batch Item Transfer Utility
requirements.description: The system shall provide a utility for authorized staff to transfer batches of Items between Branches, mobile units, outreach collections, and temporary locations. The utility shall support bulk relocation as part of collection balancing and scheduled programs. Acceptance shall include transferring a selected batch while recording its source and destination.
requirements.priority_rationale: Batch transfer is the core purpose of this topic and is explicitly requested by multiple sources as a crucial operational capability.

requirements.name: Manually Select Transfer Items
requirements.description: The system shall allow staff to manually select individual Items or titles from transfer-query results. Selection shall support choosing a subset of results rather than requiring the entire result set to be transferred. Acceptance shall include selecting and deselecting individual results before a transfer is initiated.
requirements.priority_rationale: Staff explicitly require targeted selection to prevent unsuitable Items from being included in bulk actions.

requirements.name: Protect Checked-Out Items
requirements.description: The system shall prevent event-based automatic reversion when a transferred Item has been checked out at the destination Branch. The Item shall remain at the destination until the checkout-related condition no longer prevents reversion or an authorized staff member resolves it. Acceptance shall include confirming that a checked-out Item is not automatically returned by an otherwise matching reversion rule.
requirements.priority_rationale: Preventing reversion of an Item in active use is a direct safety requirement that avoids disrupting Patron Circulation.

requirements.name: Query Transfer Candidates
requirements.description: The system shall allow authorized staff to query Items to identify candidates for transfer using criteria such as Branch, section, genre, circulation history, and inactivity. Staff shall be able to run the query and use its results as the input to a transfer operation. Acceptance shall include identifying Items such as those in a specified section that have not circulated for a configured period.
requirements.priority_rationale: Candidate identification is required for practical batch transfers and is requested across several sources.

requirements.name: Restrict Transfer Permissions
requirements.description: The system shall restrict transfer operations to staff whose Role grants the required transfer permissions. Unauthorized staff shall be prevented from initiating or applying Branch transfers. Acceptance shall include allowing an authorized Role to perform a transfer and denying the same action to an unauthorized Role.
requirements.priority_rationale: Transfer permissions affect Item custody and location integrity, so access control is essential.

requirements.name: Time-Based Item Reversion
requirements.description: The system shall automatically revert transferred Items to their original location after a configured period. Staff shall be able to configure the applicable reversion period for a transfer or transfer group. Acceptance shall include reverting an eligible Item after the configured period and preserving the original location as the destination.
requirements.priority_rationale: Automatic return after temporary deployments is explicitly described as important and is needed to manage recurring mobile and outreach transfers.

requirements.name: Update Item Locations
requirements.description: The system shall update the location of selected Items in bulk to reflect movement to a new Branch or temporary location. The update shall change the relevant Item records as part of the transfer workflow. Acceptance shall include verifying that every selected Item has the new location and that unselected Items are unchanged.
requirements.priority_rationale: Updating Item locations is the essential system action that records a completed transfer and is requested by multiple sources.

requirements.name: Criteria-Based Item Reversion
requirements.description: The system shall support automatic reversion rules triggered by configurable Item criteria or status events. Rules shall support events such as an Item becoming sold or returned and shall remove or revert the Item from the applicable transfer placement as configured. Acceptance shall include configuring a supported event and verifying the resulting reversion for an eligible Item.
requirements.priority_rationale: Event-based reversion is requested in several forms and reduces errors when temporary transfer conditions change.

requirements.name: Generate Transfer Pull Lists
requirements.description: The system shall generate printable pull lists for the Items selected for transfer. Each pull list shall identify the Items needed for physical retrieval and the relevant transfer source and destination information. Acceptance shall include producing a readable list containing all and only the Items in the transfer selection.
requirements.priority_rationale: Pull lists directly support the physical retrieval step and are explicitly identified as a transfer mechanism, although manual lists provide a temporary workaround.

requirements.name: Manage Temporary Locations
requirements.description: The system shall allow authorized staff to create and use temporary locations for events, outreach programs, mobile units, and temporary warehouses. Items shall be assignable to these locations through the transfer workflow and shall retain their original location for later reversion. Acceptance shall include assigning Items to a temporary location and making that location available for the configured transfer process.
requirements.priority_rationale: Temporary placement is explicitly needed for events and outreach operations, though permanent Branch transfers remain the core use case.

requirements.name: Preview And Confirm Transfers
requirements.description: The system shall display a preview of pending transfer actions before applying them. The preview shall include at least the Item count and source and destination locations, and the system shall require explicit staff confirmation before changing records. Acceptance shall include canceling from the preview without changes and confirming to apply the displayed transfer.
requirements.priority_rationale: Confirmation reduces costly bulk-transfer errors and is clearly requested, while a carefully reviewed manual process is a temporary workaround.

requirements.name: Print Transit Labels
requirements.description: The system shall generate printable Transit labels for Items included in a transfer. Labels shall support barcode-based identification during physical movement and shall be associated with the relevant Items. Acceptance shall include printing labels for a selected transfer and verifying that each label identifies its Item.
requirements.priority_rationale: Labels improve reliable physical handling and tracking of transferred Items, but transfers can temporarily proceed with manual labeling.

requirements.name: Schedule Reversion Processing
requirements.description: The system shall run a scheduled background task that evaluates transferred Items against configured time-based and event-based reversion rules. The task shall apply eligible reversion actions without requiring staff to inspect every transfer manually. Acceptance shall include scheduling an evaluation and verifying that eligible Items are processed while ineligible Items remain unchanged.
requirements.priority_rationale: Scheduled processing is necessary for dependable automatic reversion, although staff could temporarily perform the checks manually.

requirements.name: Track Item Transfer History
requirements.description: The system shall maintain a history of transfers for each Item. The history shall include transfer dates, locations, and enough information to determine how often the Item has been transferred during a specified period. Acceptance shall include viewing an Item history and counting its transfers within a selected time range.
requirements.priority_rationale: Transfer history supports identification of problematic movement patterns and is explicitly requested for operational analysis.

requirements.name: Undo Transfer Operations
requirements.description: The system shall allow an authorized staff member to undo a transfer operation and restore affected Items to their previous locations. The undo action shall identify the transfer being reversed and shall not alter unrelated Item locations. Acceptance shall include undoing a completed transfer and verifying restoration of all affected Items.
requirements.priority_rationale: Undo capability provides important recovery from bulk-action errors, although authorized staff could otherwise restore locations manually.

requirements.name: Alert On Transfer Issues
requirements.description: The system shall notify designated staff when a transfer is delayed or encounters a configured transfer issue. Notifications shall identify the affected transfer and provide enough information for staff to investigate and take corrective action. Acceptance shall include generating a notification for a simulated delay or issue and verifying delivery to the designated recipients.
requirements.priority_rationale: Issue alerts improve operational response but are a desirable enhancement because staff can monitor transfers through other procedures.

requirements.name: Branch Capacity Analysis
requirements.description: The system shall provide Reports and analysis of Branch capacity and the distribution of the collection among Branches. The analysis shall support evaluation of available capacity and identification of an optimal collection distribution. Managers shall be able to use the results to support collection planning across Branches.
requirements.priority_rationale: Branch capacity and collection distribution are explicitly requested in multiple documents and support system-level planning.

requirements.name: Collection Use Analysis
requirements.description: The system shall provide Reports and analysis of the collection and its use by Patrons to support collection management decisions. The analysis shall support metrics such as Circulation statistics and collection utilization. The resulting Reports shall enable management to evaluate use patterns and make evidence-based collection decisions.
requirements.priority_rationale: Collection-use analysis is explicitly requested in multiple documents and directly supports core collection management decisions.

requirements.name: Manager Planning Reports
requirements.description: The system shall provide Reports that library managers can use for planning and evaluation. The Reports shall present relevant operational or program metrics in a form suitable for comparing results against management objectives. The system shall make the Reports available for routine management review.
requirements.priority_rationale: Managerial planning and evaluation are explicitly identified as a general reporting need for routine library management.

requirements.name: Staff Productivity Analysis
requirements.description: The system shall provide Reports and analysis of staff productivity and workflow for operational management and process improvement. The analysis shall support productivity metrics, including time spent per Transaction where that data is available. Managers shall be able to use the results to inform staffing and workflow decisions.
requirements.priority_rationale: Staff productivity analysis is requested in three candidates and supports operational management, staffing, and process improvement.

requirements.name: Collection Development Reports
requirements.description: The system shall support Reports for collection development activities. The Reports shall provide relevant collection development metrics through either maintained Canned Reports or easily created custom Reports. The available metrics shall support evaluation and planning of collection development decisions.
requirements.priority_rationale: Collection development reporting is a clearly stated stakeholder need, although it can initially be supported through general Report capabilities.

requirements.name: Executive Strategic Reports
requirements.description: The system shall produce aggregated, high-level Reports for Library Administrators. The Reports shall support strategic planning and preparation of board presentations. Aggregation shall summarize relevant data and metrics at a level appropriate for executive and board review.
requirements.priority_rationale: Executive and board reporting is explicitly requested, but operational management reports provide a temporary workaround for some planning needs.

requirements.name: Program Attendance Reports
requirements.description: The system shall support Reports for recording and analyzing attendance at library programs. The Reports shall allow attendance data to be summarized for program evaluation and planning. The results shall support management review of program participation.
