requirements.priority_rationale: Program attendance reporting is explicitly requested and supports evaluation and planning, but it is less central than broad management analytics.

requirements.name: Geographic Age Demographics
requirements.description: The system shall produce aggregated demographic statistics from transaction data grouped by geographic region, including ZIP code, and Patron age range. The outputs shall support programming, outreach, collection, and service planning. Acceptance shall verify that users can obtain counts or statistics for selected geographic and age groupings.
requirements.priority_rationale: Geographic and age analysis is requested by several sources and is a core demographic reporting need.

requirements.name: Geographic Patron Counts
requirements.description: The system shall provide Patron counts grouped by county, city, and ZIP code. The Report shall support both a county-only view and combined geographic groupings for analysis of Patron distribution and outreach planning. Acceptance shall verify that counts reflect each populated geographic value and that missing values are handled consistently.
requirements.priority_rationale: Multiple sources explicitly request county, city, and ZIP-level Patron counts for geographic analysis and outreach.

requirements.name: Patron Characteristic Reporting
requirements.description: The system shall allow Queries and Reports to filter and group Patron records by age or birthdate, postal code, county, home Branch, Patron type, and preferred language. These characteristics shall be sourced authoritatively from the Patron data source and shall support both individual filters, such as a specific postal code, and grouped analysis. Acceptance shall verify that each supported characteristic can be selected, filtered, and grouped while remaining correctly associated with its Patron record.
requirements.priority_rationale: The requested demographic Reports depend on consistent Patron characteristics and are explicitly identified as essential planning capabilities.

requirements.name: Patron Demographic Planning
requirements.description: The system shall provide Reports and analysis of Patron demographics and interests to support service planning, programming, outreach, and collection development. The analysis shall use available Patron characteristics and support community-level interpretation without requiring individual Patron identification. Acceptance shall include generation of demographic outputs suitable for planning decisions.
requirements.priority_rationale: Multiple stakeholder sources identify demographic analysis as a core purpose of this reporting capability.

requirements.name: Reportable Patron Fields
requirements.description: The system shall expose the defined Patron fields for use in Report generation, including identifier, barcode, OPAC status, home Branch, Patron type, email, address lines, city, state, ZIP code, birth date, and creation date. Field exposure shall follow the applicable privacy and permission rules. Acceptance shall verify that each supported field can be selected or used by an authorized Report.
requirements.priority_rationale: These fields provide the data foundation required for demographic grouping and filtering.

requirements.name: Total Patron Count
requirements.description: The system shall provide a Report containing the total number of Patrons in the System. The count shall be available for demographic and operational tracking. Acceptance shall verify that the result can be reconciled with the selected Patron population.
requirements.priority_rationale: A total Patron count is a basic operational measure needed for demographic reporting and planning.

requirements.name: Circulation By Patron Age
requirements.description: The system shall provide Patron counts and Circulation counts grouped by defined Patron age demographic buckets. Users shall be able to compare the Patron population and Circulation activity across age groups. Acceptance shall verify that each included Patron and Circulation Transaction is assigned to the correct configured age bucket or handled according to the defined missing-age rule.
requirements.priority_rationale: Age-based population and Circulation analysis is explicitly requested but is not required for basic Circulation reporting.

requirements.name: Filter By Survey Name
requirements.description: The system shall allow users to select a survey by its human-readable name when defining a Report filter. The system shall resolve the selected name to the corresponding survey identifier internally. Acceptance shall verify that filtering by survey name produces the same records as filtering by its identifier.
requirements.priority_rationale: Multiple sources request this usability improvement because it avoids requiring users to know internal survey identifiers.

requirements.name: List Barred Patrons
requirements.description: The system shall provide a Report listing Patrons with barred status. Authorized staff shall be able to use the list to manage access and enforcement actions. Acceptance shall verify that the Report includes all Patrons matching the selected barred status and excludes others.
requirements.priority_rationale: The capability supports operational Patron administration, although it is not required for core demographic analysis.

requirements.name: New Patron Demographic Counts
requirements.description: The system shall Report Patrons added during the previous month grouped by demographic category. The Report shall identify the reporting month and provide counts for each available demographic category. Acceptance shall verify that the result includes only Patrons added during the specified previous month.
requirements.priority_rationale: New Patron trends support planning and outreach, but a manual count can temporarily provide this information.

requirements.name: Patron Behavior Analytics
requirements.description: The system shall produce statistics and analytical outputs that support understanding and prediction of Patron behavior and Item use. Outputs shall support measures such as renewal likelihood, return speed, average return time, and the percentage of renewals. Acceptance shall verify that these measures can be generated from available historical data.
requirements.priority_rationale: Behavior prediction is explicitly requested but is less central than basic demographic reporting and can have temporary manual workarounds.

requirements.name: Patron Count By Branch
requirements.description: The system shall provide counts of Patrons grouped by their home Branch. The Report shall support Branch-level metrics, allocation, and service planning. Acceptance shall verify that each count is based on the Patron home Branch value.
requirements.priority_rationale: Branch-level Patron distribution is useful for allocation and planning, although it is less fundamental than overall demographic counts.

requirements.name: Patron Count By Profile
requirements.description: The system shall provide Patron counts grouped by profile group or Patron type. The Report shall support segmentation and targeted service planning. Acceptance shall verify that each Patron is counted in the configured profile group associated with the reporting population.
requirements.priority_rationale: Profile-based segmentation is a clearly requested demographic capability with practical planning value.

requirements.name: Patron Lists By Expiration
requirements.description: The system shall produce lists of Patrons grouped or filtered by card or account expiration date. The lists shall support renewal management and outreach. Acceptance shall verify that Patrons appear in the correct expiration-date grouping or match the selected expiration-date criteria.
requirements.priority_rationale: Expiration-date lists support routine Patron management and outreach but are not essential to demographic analysis.

requirements.name: Patron Reports By Survey Answer
requirements.description: The system shall provide counts of Patrons grouped by selected survey answer and lists of Patrons who selected a specified answer. The count and list functions shall use the selected survey and its recorded answers, with access controlled according to applicable Patron-data permissions. Acceptance shall verify that grouped counts are accurate and that every listed Patron has the selected answer.
requirements.priority_rationale: Survey-based analysis and follow-up are explicitly requested and support targeted service planning.

requirements.name: Staff Password Audit Report
requirements.description: The system shall provide a Report of staff accounts that includes the date of the last password change and the account expiration date when available. The Report shall support security auditing and compliance review. Acceptance shall verify that authorized staff can obtain these fields for each included staff account.
requirements.priority_rationale: Security auditing is important, but this specialized Report can be supplemented temporarily by administrative account review.

requirements.name: Patron Lists By Note Text
requirements.description: The system shall produce lists of Patrons whose notes contain specified wording. Authorized users shall be able to provide the wording used for matching and use the result for compliance or case management. Acceptance shall verify that the list contains only Patrons whose searchable notes match the specified wording.
requirements.priority_rationale: Note-based Patron retrieval is useful for specialized case management but is requested by only one source.

requirements.name: Voter Registration Counts
requirements.description: The system shall Report voter registration survey response counts aggregated by week. The Report shall support monitoring of voter registration campaign activity. Acceptance shall verify that each weekly count includes only responses recorded for the selected voter registration survey.
requirements.priority_rationale: Weekly voter registration monitoring is a specialized use case requested by one source and is not essential to general demographic reporting.

requirements.name: Voter Responses By County Week
requirements.description: The system shall Report voter survey responses aggregated by county and week. The Report shall support civic engagement outreach and analysis without exposing individual response records in the aggregate. Acceptance shall verify that responses are assigned to the correct county and reporting week.
requirements.priority_rationale: This is a specialized survey analysis requested by the working materials but has limited impact on general Patron demographics.

requirements.name: Configurable Inactivity Thresholds
requirements.description: The system shall allow staff to define the Inactivity threshold as any whole number of days. The system shall provide common presets for approximately monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and annual periods, including 30, 90, 180, and 365 days. Staff shall be able to select a preset or enter a different value for each Report execution.
requirements.priority_rationale: The inactive Patron definition varies by operational use, and several candidates explicitly require both adjustable and preset periods.

requirements.name: Inactive Patron Exclusions
requirements.description: The system shall allow staff to exclude selected Patron types, flags, or categories from the inactive Patron Report. Exclusion criteria shall support cases such as do-not-disturb Patrons, VIPs, staff Patrons, and Patrons who have opted out of communications. Excluded records shall not appear in the resulting inactive Patron list.
requirements.priority_rationale: Excluding protected or unsuitable accounts is necessary to avoid inappropriate cleanup or outreach.

requirements.name: Inactive Patron Report
requirements.description: The system shall generate a Report listing Patrons with no qualifying Circulation or electronic activity within a configurable Inactivity period. The Report shall support filtering by System, home Branch, county, and other available Patron criteria, including compound demographic and activity conditions. Staff shall be able to use the Report for account maintenance, cleanup, outreach, and reactivation efforts. The Report shall be available for manual execution.
requirements.priority_rationale: Multiple sources identify the inactive Patron list as an essential operational need for cleanup and outreach.

requirements.name: Aggregated Patron Metrics
requirements.description: The system shall provide aggregate metrics for Patron Reports, including Patron counts and applicable Circulation or checkout counts. Staff shall be able to group these metrics by Patron characteristics such as age range or home Branch. The Report shall present the aggregated values for the selected filters and groups.
requirements.priority_rationale: Aggregated metrics extend the inactive-Patron analysis and are explicitly requested for planning and comparison.

requirements.name: Branch Cleanup Assignment
requirements.description: The system shall allow authorized staff to view inactive Patron results in the context of a home Branch and assign cleanup or follow-up work to a specific Branch. An assignment shall identify the relevant Branch and associated inactive Patron list or selection. Staff shall be able to use the assignment to coordinate operational follow-up.
requirements.priority_rationale: Branch assignment supports the stated cleanup workflow but is less fundamental than generating the inactive Patron list.

requirements.name: Configurable Age Brackets
requirements.description: The system shall allow staff to define custom age brackets for Patron filtering and grouping within a Report. Brackets may use locally selected ranges such as 0-5, 6-10, and 11-15 or other nonoverlapping ranges. The selected bracket definitions shall be applied consistently to the Report results.
requirements.priority_rationale: Multiple candidates request configurable age groupings to support different reporting and planning needs.

requirements.name: Inactive Patron Mailing Addresses
requirements.description: The system shall include each inactive Patron's current mailing address in the inactive Patron Report when that address is available. The address fields shall be associated with the corresponding Patron record. Staff shall be able to use the Report output to perform direct outreach such as postcard mailings.
requirements.priority_rationale: Mailing addresses directly support the requested outreach use case but are not required to identify inactivity.

requirements.name: Inactive Patrons By Branch
requirements.description: The system shall provide counts of inactive Patrons grouped by Branch when the Report is viewed at the System level. Staff shall be able to compare Branch counts to identify locations with the greatest number of inactive accounts. The counts shall reflect the selected Inactivity threshold and other active filters.
requirements.priority_rationale: Branch-level counts support System administration and are explicitly requested for identifying cleanup priorities.

requirements.name: Incomplete Patron Data Handling
requirements.description: The system shall handle missing values in optional Patron fields without failing or silently excluding the affected Patron records. Reports shall retain those records and represent unavailable field values as null or an equivalent explicit empty value. The behavior shall be consistent for filtering, grouping, and output.
requirements.priority_rationale: Incomplete Patron data is expected in normal operations, and predictable handling is necessary to prevent misleading results.

requirements.name: Logical Filter Combination
requirements.description: The system shall allow staff to combine Report filters with logical AND and OR operators. The resulting Query shall apply the combined conditions to the selected Patron records. The system shall make it possible to express compound criteria without requiring separate Reports for each condition.
requirements.priority_rationale: Compound filtering is needed for practical Patron targeting, but a limited single-condition workaround exists.

requirements.name: Outstanding Fine Flag
requirements.description: The system shall identify inactive Patrons who have outstanding Fines in the inactive Patron Report. The Report shall provide a flag or separate indicator that distinguishes those accounts from inactive Patrons without outstanding Fines. Staff shall be able to use this indicator when deciding on cleanup or outreach actions.
requirements.priority_rationale: Outstanding Fines affect how staff handle inactive accounts and are explicitly requested as a separate operational distinction.

requirements.name: Scheduled Inactivity Reports
requirements.description: The system shall allow authorized staff to schedule recurring executions of the inactive Patron Report, including periodic runs such as quarterly cleanup checks. The system shall also support manual ad hoc execution. Each execution shall use the configured Inactivity threshold and Report criteria for that run.
requirements.priority_rationale: Recurring inactive-Patron checks are part of the stated cleanup process, while manual execution remains an available workaround.

requirements.name: Centralized Multi-Branch Operations
requirements.description: The system shall support centralized management processes that accept input from and provide services to multiple Branches within a System or consortium. It shall maintain a centralized operational view while supporting services across the participating locations. Acceptance shall verify that authorized central processes can receive and serve data for multiple Branches.
requirements.priority_rationale: Centralized operation across multiple Branches is fundamental to the target consortium architecture.

requirements.name: Protect Deleted Item Visibility
requirements.description: The system shall prevent front-line staff from modifying Report Templates in ways that expose deleted Items when such visibility is not permitted. Template permissions or validation shall enforce the applicable restriction. Acceptance shall verify that a front-line staff account cannot create or alter a Template to display deleted Items.
requirements.priority_rationale: Preventing inappropriate exposure of deleted Items is an explicit control on staff reporting capabilities.

requirements.name: Query OPAC Activity Data
requirements.description: The system shall interact with the OPAC to query patron-created data needed for Reports, including Holds and Circulation transactions. The system shall use this data to reflect patron activity in management Reports. The integration shall be read-only and shall not create, alter, or delete OPAC data.
requirements.priority_rationale: Reports require reliable access to patron activity while preserving the OPAC as the system of record for public-facing data.

requirements.name: WorldCat Integration Support
requirements.description: The system shall provide integration with, or direct assistance for accessing, WorldCat records. Catalogers shall be able to examine or edit relevant WorldCat records when handling last-copy Items. The integration shall help prevent accidental deletion of Items that may require cataloging review.
requirements.priority_rationale: The working group explicitly identified WorldCat integration as critical for protecting last-copy Items.

requirements.name: Historical Data Reporting
requirements.description: The system shall allow authorized users to request a Report showing the state of relevant data as of a specified past date. The Report shall preserve historical values for attributes that may have changed since that date, such as shelving location. Acceptance shall verify that a historical request returns values associated with the selected date rather than only current values.
requirements.priority_rationale: Historical views are clearly requested but are less central to daily platform operation than core integrations and performance.

requirements.name: Historical Reporting Warehouse
requirements.description: The system shall support historical reporting through a reporting warehouse or equivalent historical data store. Authorized users shall be able to retrieve data for a specified date or date range to perform point-in-time analysis without relying solely on current operational values. Acceptance shall verify that historical snapshots can be queried for requested periods without adversely affecting production operations.
requirements.priority_rationale: Historical analysis is repeatedly requested and valuable, but current-data reporting provides a temporary operational alternative.

requirements.name: Integrate Vendor Data
requirements.description: The system shall interface with vendor websites through published APIs or automated transfer of standard-format data files. Supported integrations shall accommodate formats such as USMARC21 and EDIFACT. Where provided by a vendor, the system shall handle EDI ordering data.
requirements.priority_rationale: Vendor integration is important for operational data exchange, but a temporary manual exchange process may be possible.

requirements.name: Local Administrative Configuration
requirements.description: The system shall allow Local System Administrators to configure settings and reporting options for their organizational units. It shall restrict each administrator's configuration scope to the applicable Branch or organizational unit. Acceptance shall verify that authorized local administrators can change local settings and run system Reports without requiring central administration.
requirements.priority_rationale: Local configuration is clearly requested by multiple stakeholders, but central administration provides a temporary workaround.

requirements.name: Migrate Environment Configuration
requirements.description: The system shall support migration of configuration between development, testing, and production environments. Authorized staff shall be able to export and import Report Templates, permission settings, and saved Queries. Acceptance shall verify that exported configuration can be imported into another supported environment without re-creating each element manually.
requirements.priority_rationale: Environment migration reduces deployment risk and is explicitly required by the later technical-subcommittee decision.

requirements.name: Reports For Notices Sent
requirements.description: The system shall provide Reports on notices sent to Patrons. The Reports shall distinguish at least pre-overdue, overdue, and Hold notices. Authorized staff shall be able to use the results to track Patron communications.
requirements.priority_rationale: Notice tracking is a concrete operational reporting need, although it is narrower than the platform's core integration capabilities.

requirements.name: Batch Item Status Conversion
requirements.description: The system shall provide a Report and tools to select Items for batch conversion from one status to another. Staff shall be able to review the Items selected for conversion and apply the new status to many Items in one operation, such as changing Items from missing to discard/weed. The operation shall support large selections efficiently to reduce manual cataloging and cleanup work.
requirements.priority_rationale: Batch status conversion is repeatedly requested as a core efficiency need for large-scale cleanup.

requirements.name: Controlled Purge Execution
requirements.description: The system shall present purge candidates in a read-only view before any destructive operation is performed. It shall require a distinct confirmation step before deleting or purging selected records and shall provide safeguards such as review and permission checks to prevent accidental mass deletion. The safeguards shall apply to both individually selected records and large batch selections.
requirements.priority_rationale: Separate review and confirmation are essential to prevent irreversible loss of collection data.

requirements.name: Identify Purge Candidates
requirements.description: The system shall provide a utility and Reports that identify Item records eligible for purging using staff-configurable criteria. Criteria shall include specific Item status values, time spent in a status, last Circulation date or elapsed time since last Circulation, and combinations of criteria using logical operators such as AND and OR. The resulting candidate list shall support planning and review of weeding and cleanup actions.
requirements.priority_rationale: Identifying records safely and consistently is the core purpose of Record Purging and is requested by multiple sources.

requirements.name: Purge Volumes And Orphans
requirements.description: The system shall provide a cleanup function that can delete a volume together with its associated Items when the operation is authorized. It shall identify and remove Bibliographic Records with no associated Items and other orphaned records, including records whose parent relationship is missing. The cleanup function shall support bulk processing and shall provide an appropriate removal or repair action for each detected orphan type.
requirements.priority_rationale: Removing empty volumes and orphaned catalog records is a core data-cleanup need requested by multiple sources.

requirements.name: Sole Item Purge Flagging
requirements.description: The system shall determine whether each Item considered for purge is the only Item for its Bibliographic Record within a selected Branch or across the System. Purge candidate Reports shall clearly flag the applicable sole-Item condition and identify relevant holdings or ownership information. The information shall help staff review local and System-wide consequences before deletion and update external catalog records when necessary.
requirements.priority_rationale: Avoiding deletion of local or System-wide sole Items is a critical collection-protection requirement.

requirements.name: Report Deleted Sole Copies
requirements.description: The system shall provide Reports of Items that were deleted and were the last copy within the System or a Branch. The Reports shall identify the deleted Item and the scope in which it was the sole copy. Staff shall be able to use the results for local collection maintenance and for updating external catalog records such as WorldCat.
requirements.priority_rationale: Post-deletion sole-copy reporting is clearly requested for catalog maintenance, although it is less central than preventing inappropriate deletion.

requirements.name: Schedule Purge Operations
requirements.description: The system shall allow authorized administrators to run purge-identification Reports and cleanup utilities either manually or according to a configurable schedule. Schedules shall support recurring executions, including an annual execution such as at the end of each year. The system shall execute the configured operation without requiring staff to start it manually at the scheduled time.
requirements.priority_rationale: Recurring automated purging is important for ongoing weeding but manual execution provides a workable interim approach.

requirements.name: Boolean Query Logic
requirements.description: The system shall allow staff to combine Query criteria with Boolean operators including AND, OR, and NOT. The Query interface shall support nested Boolean logic for compound selection criteria. The resulting Query shall apply the specified logic consistently when selecting records for a Report.
requirements.priority_rationale: Complex Boolean logic is required to express many practical reporting selections and is explicitly demanded across sources.

requirements.name: Controlled Template Editing
requirements.description: The system shall allow administrators to specify, for each Template and applicable Role, which filters and display fields staff may alter. The system shall preserve protected criteria and fields when a Template is modified, such as preventing staff from exposing deleted Items while allowing an authorized call number range. Changes to Template parameters shall not compromise the correctness, integrity, or certified consistency of the resulting Report.
requirements.priority_rationale: Controlled editing is necessary to preserve dependable results while still allowing authorized staff customization.

requirements.name: Display Query Criteria
requirements.description: The system shall display the Query selections and criteria used to generate a Report alongside or within its results. The displayed criteria shall identify the filters and selections that produced the result set. This shall enable staff to understand and verify how the Report was produced.
requirements.priority_rationale: Showing criteria is important for interpreting and verifying Reports and is explicitly requested by several sources.

requirements.name: Field Selection And Filtering
requirements.description: The system shall expose the relevant available database fields for Report authoring, including Item fields such as identifier, barcode, label, copy number, Branch, status, circulation modifier, call number, purchase date, purchase price, and shelving location. Staff shall be able to select fields for a Query through the authoring interface, including visual drag-and-drop selection where supported. Reports and Queries shall allow filtering by selected standard, advanced, and custom fields, and shall support basic result sorting.
requirements.priority_rationale: Selecting and filtering report fields is a core capability needed for targeted daily reporting.

requirements.name: Interactive Report Authoring
requirements.description: The system shall provide a browser-based report writer that enables staff, including front-line and supervisory staff, to create, store, and execute custom Reports. The interface shall support report authoring without developer assistance and shall retain locally created Reports for later reuse. Staff shall be able to contribute report content needed by their Branch or System.
requirements.priority_rationale: Interactive staff authoring is central to creating the custom Reports required by multiple stakeholders.

requirements.name: Report Template Management
requirements.description: The system shall allow administrators to create, maintain, version, and distribute reusable Templates for staff across the System. Templates shall contain standardized Report definitions that can be reused by multiple Branches without recreating the underlying criteria and fields. The system shall support the set of Templates needed for standardized reporting across the participating Branches.
requirements.priority_rationale: Reusable standardized Templates are a core requirement requested by administrators and the working group for consistent System-wide reporting.

requirements.name: Run Or Modify Templates
requirements.description: The system shall allow staff to run an authorized Template without changing its definition. It shall also allow staff to create an authorized modified version for individual reporting needs while preserving the original Template. Administrator-defined limits and edit controls shall be applied whenever a staff member modifies a Template.
requirements.priority_rationale: Running standardized Templates and making controlled local variations are explicitly required for routine staff reporting.

requirements.name: Support Specified Report Definitions
requirements.description: The system shall support the Report definitions and fine-grained reporting requirements specified in Appendix A and Appendix B of the applicable requirements specification. Each specified definition shall be representable through the system's available fields, criteria, and output behavior. Conformance shall be verified against the approved Appendix A and Appendix B examples.
requirements.priority_rationale: The specification explicitly requires support for the approved Report definitions that establish the expected reporting scope.

requirements.name: Clone Report Definitions
requirements.description: The system shall allow authorized staff to clone an existing Report or Template into a new Report definition. Cloning shall copy the source definition sufficiently to create a variant without changing the original. The new definition shall be independently editable and stored.
requirements.priority_rationale: Cloning improves reuse and protects standard definitions, but staff can otherwise recreate a variant manually.

requirements.name: Cross-Tabulation And Pivoting
requirements.description: The system shall support cross-tabulation and pivot-style analysis of Report data across terminal, Branch, System, hour, Patron age range, Patron type, and Patron location. Staff shall be able to summarize data by selected dimensions and inspect the resulting aggregated values. The capability may be provided interactively within the reporting tool or through pivot-table-style Report output.
requirements.priority_rationale: Cross-tabulation is repeatedly requested for analysis across operational dimensions, although basic Reports remain usable without it.

requirements.name: Edit Canned Report Displays
requirements.description: The system shall allow administrators or other authorized staff to edit the display fields of a Canned Report without changing its underlying selection logic. Staff shall be able to add or remove permitted display fields, such as shelving location. The resulting Canned Report shall present the configured display fields when executed.
requirements.priority_rationale: Adjustable display fields are useful for local reporting needs, while the underlying Canned Report can otherwise remain usable.

requirements.name: Picklist Query Values
requirements.description: The system shall provide picklists of valid values when staff compose Query criteria. Staff shall be able to select a value from the applicable picklist instead of entering it manually. The selected value shall be retained as part of the Query criteria.
requirements.priority_rationale: Picklists reduce entry errors and simplify Query construction, but manual entry provides a temporary workaround.

requirements.name: Regular Expression Queries
requirements.description: The system shall support regular expression matching in Query criteria for advanced string and pattern searches. The Query interface shall provide a selectable list or drop-down of available regular expressions where applicable. A Query using a regular expression shall execute and return records matching the specified pattern.
requirements.priority_rationale: Advanced pattern matching is explicitly requested for complex reporting but is less essential than basic Query capabilities.

requirements.name: Reusable Report And Query Definitions
requirements.description: The system shall allow authorized staff to save Report and Query definitions for reuse across sessions. A saved definition shall retain its fields, criteria, formatting, and other execution parameters needed to rerun it without rebuilding the definition. Staff shall be able to reuse saved definitions for recurring reporting and transfer-selection work, and acceptance shall verify that permitted definitions can be saved and executed later with their criteria intact.
requirements.priority_rationale: Repeated Report and transfer-selection work is explicitly requested, although staff can temporarily recreate definitions manually.

requirements.name: Explicit Null And Blank Values
requirements.description: The system shall include null and blank field values explicitly in Report results when the corresponding fields are selected. It shall not implicitly omit or hide records or field values solely because a selected field is null or blank. Filters shall continue to apply according to their defined criteria, while null and blank values that satisfy those criteria remain represented in the result. Acceptance shall verify that records containing null or blank selected fields retain visible, distinguishable representations in generated and exported results.
requirements.priority_rationale: Four source documents request complete visibility of null and blank values, making this important for reliable analysis and record counts.

requirements.name: Multiple Report Export Formats
requirements.description: The system shall export Reports in Excel, HTML, and CSV formats. The formats shall support web presentation, reliable data exchange, spreadsheet-based analysis, and business-user workflows. Each format shall be selectable for a generated Report and shall contain the Report's result data. Export acceptance shall verify that the resulting files or rendered output can be opened or consumed in the corresponding format.
requirements.priority_rationale: Multiple source documents request these formats, and the meeting record explicitly identifies Excel, HTML, and CSV as required.

requirements.name: Email Report Results
requirements.description: The system shall allow authorized Report users to specify one or more email recipients for generated Reports. It shall deliver results either on demand or after a scheduled Report execution, using the selected supported export format. The system shall preserve the generated result and identify delivery failures when email delivery cannot be completed.
requirements.priority_rationale: Email delivery is explicitly requested by multiple sources and provides an important alternative to retrieving results through the web interface.

requirements.name: MARC Values Per Record
requirements.description: The system shall extract selected MARC values from Bibliographic Records and present them on a single Report row per Bibliographic Record. The output shall retain the association between each selected value and its record, with repeated values combined according to the Report's defined representation rather than creating extra rows by default. Acceptance shall verify that selected MARC fields are extracted correctly and that each record occupies no more than one result row unless repetition is explicitly requested.
requirements.priority_rationale: Single-row MARC extraction supports important catalog analysis but is less foundational than core Item and quality Reports.

requirements.name: Text File Report Filtering
requirements.description: The system shall allow an authorized Report user to upload a text file containing identifiers such as barcodes or TCNs. It shall use the identifiers from the uploaded file as filter input for a Report. The system shall apply the resulting identifier set to the selected field and produce results for matching records. Acceptance shall verify that a file containing known identifiers returns the corresponding records and excludes records whose identifiers are absent from the file.
requirements.priority_rationale: Two sources request this capability to support large filter lists, although it is an efficiency feature rather than a prerequisite for ordinary Report filtering.

requirements.name: Deduplicated Excel Results
requirements.description: The system shall produce Excel exports with one row for each distinct result identified by the Report's result definition. It shall not introduce duplicate rows through the export process or through repeated values in unrelated joined fields. Legitimate repeated rows shall remain only when the Report definition identifies them as distinct results. Acceptance shall compare the Excel export with the defined Report result identity and verify that export processing does not create unintended duplicates.
requirements.priority_rationale: Clean Excel output is useful for analysis but is requested by only one source and can often be mitigated through Report design or spreadsheet cleanup.

requirements.name: Predefined Board Executive Reports
requirements.description: The system shall provide predefined Reports for library boards and executive stakeholders without requiring staff to design them ad hoc. These Reports shall include basic statistics needed for applicable state reporting, including the Georgia Annual Report and Application for State Aid. The predefined Reports shall be available for governance and external-consumer information needs.
requirements.priority_rationale: Multiple sources explicitly require these core governance and state-reporting Reports.

requirements.name: Systemwide Statistical Reports
requirements.description: The system shall enable the Global System Administrator to generate statistical Reports for the entire System. The Reports shall support systemwide and consortium-level analysis across the associated Branches. Access to this capability shall be available to the Global System Administrator in accordance with the administrator's responsibilities.
requirements.priority_rationale: Systemwide statistical reporting is explicitly required for administration of the entire System.

requirements.name: Three Reporting Interfaces
requirements.description: The system shall provide distinct interfaces for Canned Reports, on-demand Reports, and open Template reporting. The interfaces shall support different levels of staff expertise and reporting needs. Each interface shall be identifiable as a separate reporting mode and shall be available from the reporting functionality.
requirements.priority_rationale: The three-interface model is explicitly requested in multiple sources to serve different reporting use cases.

requirements.name: Comparative Period Columns
requirements.description: The system shall support Report columns that compare the current reporting period with prior periods. A Report shall be able to show the previous month's Circulation, the corresponding prior-year month, and percentage differences for the applicable comparisons. The comparison periods and percentage calculations shall be identifiable in the Report output.
requirements.priority_rationale: Comparative period analysis is explicitly requested and materially supports interpretation of Report results.

requirements.name: Executive Reports Interface
requirements.description: The system shall provide an Executive Reports Interface tailored to executive and board information needs. The interface shall include the Reports identified by the responsible working group as required for executive use. Staff shall be able to access the compiled executive Report set through that interface.
requirements.priority_rationale: The working group explicitly requested an executive interface and compiled Report set, but general reporting remains a temporary fallback.

requirements.name: Management Reporting Tools
requirements.description: The system shall provide Reports and analysis tools for managers, administrators, and staff. These tools shall support planning, evaluation, and operational oversight. The Reports shall present library data in a form that enables those stakeholders to review performance and inform management decisions.
requirements.priority_rationale: Management reporting supports broad stakeholder needs and is explicitly identified as a purpose of the reporting capability.

requirements.name: On-Demand Report Criteria
requirements.description: The system shall provide an on-demand Report interface that starts from preset Reports while allowing staff to modify selection criteria before execution. Staff shall also be able to adjust the display options for the resulting Report. The system shall apply the modified criteria and display options to the generated Report.
requirements.priority_rationale: On-demand modification is an important reporting capability, although predefined Reports provide a temporary workaround.

requirements.name: Open Template Reporting
requirements.description: The system shall provide an open Template reporting interface for power users to create reusable Report definitions. The interface shall expose attributes associated with Circulation, Items, Patrons, Fines, and Bibliographic Records for filtering and display selection. A user shall be able to select the desired attributes and save a reusable Template.
requirements.priority_rationale: Open Template reporting is explicitly requested for advanced and reusable reporting, but basic Canned Reports provide a temporary workaround.

requirements.name: Report Quick Access Descriptions
requirements.description: The system shall provide a quick-access interface for Reports and Templates. Each Canned Report or Template title shall display a description when the user hovers over it. The description shall help the user identify the purpose of the selected Report or Template before opening or running it.
requirements.priority_rationale: Multiple sources request this usability feature to help staff identify Reports quickly, though Reports remain usable without it.

requirements.name: Report Result Identification
requirements.description: The system shall include the Report name in each Report result. It shall also include the date selection criteria used to produce the result. These identifiers shall appear at the top or bottom of the result so staff can identify the Report and its date range without reopening the criteria.
requirements.priority_rationale: Result identification is explicitly requested and helps staff interpret and use Reports correctly.

requirements.name: Selectable Report Data
requirements.description: The system shall allow a user to select the data elements to include in a Report. The selection interface shall present the available data elements as individually selectable options. The generated Report shall contain the data elements selected by the user and omit unselected elements.
requirements.priority_rationale: Selectable data elements improve Report usability and are explicitly requested, but fixed Reports provide a limited workaround.

requirements.name: Current Data Reporting
requirements.description: The system shall support generating Reports from current data when staff require up-to-date results. The system shall identify the data currency or retrieval time associated with a Report generated using current data. A Report requested for current data shall use the latest data available to the reporting service at execution time.
requirements.priority_rationale: Current-data reporting is useful for operational decisions but is requested by only one source and may have a temporary manual workaround.

requirements.name: Ad Hoc Data Access Control
requirements.description: The system shall allow administrators to permit or restrict staff from running ad hoc Reports against specified sets of data. These restrictions shall be assignable by Role, group, or other administrator-defined permission scope. A staff member shall be prevented from executing an ad hoc Query when its data scope is outside the permissions granted to that staff member.
requirements.priority_rationale: Multiple sources require restrictions on ad hoc access to specific data, which is necessary to prevent unauthorized data exposure.

requirements.name: Destructive Operation Permissions
requirements.description: The system shall restrict purge and other destructive operations through Role-based permissions. Only authorized staff shall be able to delete records or perform bulk status changes through Reports or related administrative functions. The system shall deny such operations to staff whose assigned Role lacks the required permission.
requirements.priority_rationale: Restricting destructive operations is explicitly required to prevent accidental or unauthorized bulk changes.

requirements.name: Fine-Grained Report Permissions
requirements.description: The system shall provide distinct, fine-grained permissions for creating, editing, cloning, running, viewing, and modifying Reports, Queries, and Templates. Administrators shall be able to separate Report creation and maintenance permissions from Report execution permissions and control access to the Query tool and its features. Adding a Canned Report or Template shall require the corresponding permission.
requirements.priority_rationale: Fine-grained control over Report and Query authoring and execution is repeatedly requested and is essential for governance and data protection.

requirements.name: Predefined Report Roles
requirements.description: The system shall support predefined Roles with appropriate access to Reports and administrative functions, including Global Administrator, Local Administrator, Library Manager, Staff, and Patron access levels. Global Administrator access shall cover the full reporting system, while Local Administrator, Library Manager, and Staff access shall be limited according to their responsibilities and approved permissions. The system shall permit the defined role model to distinguish branch-level administration, approved Report execution, limited Template modification, and indirect Patron access.
requirements.priority_rationale: The working-group decisions define role semantics that are necessary for consistent access control across the System.

requirements.name: Role Assignment Administration
requirements.description: The system shall provide an administrative interface for creating, modifying, assigning, and managing Roles and their permissions. When an administrator changes a staff member's Role, the system shall automatically apply the permissions associated with the new Role. Role and permission administration shall support straightforward changes through Role assignment rather than requiring multiple individual permission edits.
requirements.priority_rationale: Multiple sources explicitly require simple administrative management and automatic permission changes when staff responsibilities change.

requirements.name: Role-Based Access Control
requirements.description: The system shall control staff rights and privileges through security groups and Roles. It shall assign permissions to individuals, defined workgroups, and arbitrary staff groups, and shall determine those permissions from the assigned Role when a staff member accesses the system. The access-control mechanism shall restrict Reports and related operations according to the assigned permissions.
requirements.priority_rationale: Role-based access control is explicitly requested by multiple sources and is foundational to secure Report access.

requirements.name: Table And Field Access
requirements.description: The system shall allow administrators to control staff access to database tables and individual fields used by Reports and Queries. The access rules shall support granting or denying access by Role or group. Reports and Queries shall not expose restricted tables or fields to staff who lack the corresponding permission.
requirements.priority_rationale: Table- and field-level controls are explicitly required to enforce data security and privacy.

requirements.name: Permission-Based Filter Restrictions
requirements.description: The system shall allow administrators to restrict which filters staff may use in Reports and Queries based on Roles or permissions. A staff member shall be unable to select or apply a restricted filter when the associated permission has not been granted. The restriction shall support protection of sensitive criteria as well as the resulting data.
requirements.priority_rationale: Filter restrictions provide an additional privacy control requested by the reference requirements, although broader data permissions may provide a temporary workaround.

requirements.name: Shared Report Folders
requirements.description: The system shall allow administrators to create shared folders or workspaces for saved Reports and Templates. Administrators shall be able to grant or deny specific staff members or groups permission to access or run Reports in each shared folder. Shared folders shall support controlled sharing of Report definitions and Templates without granting unrestricted access to all Reports.
requirements.priority_rationale: Shared Report folders are requested by several sources and provide important group-level governance, but individual access controls can provide a temporary workaround.

requirements.name: Cancel Report Execution
requirements.description: The system shall allow an authorized user to cancel a Report that is scheduled or currently running. The execution process shall check for cancellation signals during processing and terminate the Report within a timely, system-defined interval. The system shall update the Report status to indicate that cancellation occurred and shall release resources that are no longer needed.
requirements.priority_rationale: Cancellation is needed to correct scheduling errors and control long-running Reports that consume shared resources.

requirements.name: Flexible Report Scheduling
requirements.description: The system shall allow staff to schedule Reports for immediate execution or for hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly recurring execution. Recurring schedules shall execute automatically according to the selected frequency. Scheduled Reports shall support the available output format choices required for the resulting Report so scheduling can serve varied operational needs.
requirements.priority_rationale: Immediate and recurring execution at common frequencies is a core scheduling capability requested by multiple sources.

requirements.name: Prioritize And Preempt Reports
requirements.description: The system shall support configurable priority levels for Report jobs or Report types in the Report Queue. An authorized administrator shall be able to configure priorities so urgent Reports are processed ahead of eligible lower-priority or resource-consuming Reports. The system shall allow an authorized administrator to preempt a lower-priority Report that is running when a higher-priority Report requires execution, and shall mark the interrupted Report as preempted for operational follow-up.
requirements.priority_rationale: The source identifies urgent Report prioritization as crucial and explicitly includes preemption to address immediate reporting needs.

requirements.name: Report Queue Visibility
requirements.description: The system shall provide staff with a queue view for submitted Reports. The view shall show submission time, queue position, number of Reports ahead, and a shared execution state of queued or waiting, processing or running, completed, or failed. The interface shall provide available progress information so staff can understand expected wait and completion state.
requirements.priority_rationale: Queue position and processing-state visibility are repeatedly requested and are essential for monitoring asynchronous Report execution.

requirements.name: Edit Recurring Report Schedules
requirements.description: The system shall allow an authorized user to edit an existing recurring Report schedule. The user shall be able to add or remove Report selections and modify the email recipient list associated with the schedule. Changes shall apply to subsequent executions without requiring the recurring schedule to be recreated.
requirements.priority_rationale: Editing schedules is important for ongoing operations, although users can temporarily create a replacement schedule.

requirements.name: Batch Report Execution
requirements.description: The system shall allow staff to select multiple Reports for execution as one batch. The selected Reports shall be submitted for execution together rather than requiring separate submissions. The system shall support presenting the resulting Reports within a single document when that output arrangement is selected.
requirements.priority_rationale: Batch execution can reduce repetitive work, but users can otherwise submit Reports individually.

requirements.name: Canned Report Scheduling Interface
requirements.description: The system shall provide an interface containing the Canned Reports delivered with the product. Staff shall be able to select a Canned Report and run it immediately or schedule it for recurring execution. The interface shall identify the available Canned Reports and expose the execution choice for each selected Report.
requirements.priority_rationale: Pre-written Reports are useful for operational work, but this capability is less central than general scheduling and queue control.

requirements.name: Relative Date Report Execution
requirements.description: The system shall allow a Canned Report to use relative date ranges when it executes. Supported relative ranges shall include yesterday, last week, last month, and last year. The resulting date range shall be calculated from the execution date so the same schedule can be reused over time.
requirements.priority_rationale: Relative dates simplify recurring operational Reports but are a convenience beyond basic Report execution.

requirements.name: Report Delivery Address Book
requirements.description: The system shall provide an address book for storing and selecting regularly used email addresses for Report delivery. Staff shall be able to choose saved recipients when configuring an emailed Report or recurring schedule. The address book shall reduce repeated manual entry of recipient addresses.
requirements.priority_rationale: Saved recipients improve convenience, but users can enter email addresses manually when the address book is unavailable.

requirements.name: Branch Missing Damage Reports
requirements.description: The system shall provide Reports listing missing and damaged Items for each Branch. Branch staff and managers shall be able to use the Reports to monitor collection health, support local inventory work, and investigate losses or claims. The Report shall identify the relevant Item and its Branch so the results can be verified against inventory records.
requirements.priority_rationale: Multiple sources identify branch-level missing and damaged Item reporting as essential for accountability, inventory, and claims work.

requirements.name: Combined Transit Direction Report
requirements.description: The system shall provide a combined Report containing Items in Transit to and from Branches. Users shall not need to run separate Reports for the two Transit directions. The combined results shall support front-line staff in tracking and following up on Items moving between Branches.
requirements.priority_rationale: Multiple working-group sources explicitly require one combined Transit Report to reduce operational effort and simplify follow-up.

requirements.name: Missing Damage Counts
requirements.description: The system shall present numeric counts of missing and damaged Items in the relevant Reports. Counts shall be available for the selected scope and criteria, including Branch and date range where applicable. Users shall be able to use the counts to support inventory audits and accountability reviews.
requirements.priority_rationale: Numeric summaries are explicitly required for inventory auditing and are a core part of accountable loss reporting.

requirements.name: Periodic Overdue Transit Reports
requirements.description: The system shall generate a recurring Report of Items whose Transit duration exceeds a configurable threshold. The Report shall support periodic scheduling and scopes by Branch and by System, and shall identify each Item and its Transit information. The default threshold shall be seven days unless an administrator configures another value.
requirements.priority_rationale: Overdue Transit monitoring across Branches and the System is a core operational need, and the sources explicitly require periodic execution and a configurable threshold.

requirements.name: Transit Reports By Branches
requirements.description: The system shall provide Transit Reports that identify both the sending Branch and the destination Branch for each Item. Users shall be able to group or filter results by sending Branch and by destination Branch. These views shall support coordination of outbound shipments and delivery between Branches and central services.
requirements.priority_rationale: Movement between Branches cannot be operationally monitored without identifying both ends of each Transit, and multiple sources request these views.

requirements.name: Exportable Operational Reports
requirements.description: The system shall allow relevant missing, damaged, and Transit Reports to be delivered in a printable or commonly exportable format. Exported results shall preserve the selected records, fields, and report scope. Staff shall be able to use the resulting output for inventory audits and collection management decisions.
requirements.priority_rationale: Export or print output is clearly needed for audits and management work, while on-screen Reports provide a temporary alternative.

requirements.name: Filter By Item Status
requirements.description: The system shall allow Reports to filter Items by one or more configured status values. Status values shall include, where tracked, missing, lost, and long overdue. Users shall be able to combine status filtering with Branch or other available Report criteria.
requirements.priority_rationale: Status filtering supports operational identification of problematic Items and is clearly requested, but basic reports can temporarily be reviewed without it.

requirements.name: Item Condition Notes
requirements.description: The system shall include Item condition notes in missing and damaged Item Reports. The notes shall preserve descriptive information such as water damage or vandalism. Staff shall be able to review these notes alongside the affected Item and Branch.
requirements.priority_rationale: Condition details are important for identifying damage causes, but the core missing and damaged Report remains useful without them.

requirements.name: Missing Damage Date Filters
requirements.description: The system shall allow users to filter missing and damaged Item Reports by a selected date range. Supported ranges shall include user-defined dates and commonly used periods such as the last 30 days or last quarter. The resulting Report shall contain only records whose relevant missing or damage date falls within the selected range.
requirements.priority_rationale: Date filtering is repeatedly requested to support trend analysis, although a complete unfiltered Report provides a temporary workaround.

requirements.name: Reports By Bibliographic Record
requirements.description: The system shall allow missing and damaged Item Reports to group or aggregate results by Bibliographic Record. The grouped results shall show the number of affected Items for each Bibliographic Record. Staff shall be able to use this view to identify works that are repeatedly lost or damaged.
requirements.priority_rationale: Grouping by Bibliographic Record supports collection decisions and pattern detection but is not required for basic loss accountability.

requirements.name: Sort Transit Items By Due Date
requirements.description: The system shall allow users to sort the Transit Report by due date. The Report shall support ordering Items so that the oldest or most urgent due dates can be reviewed first. This ordering shall help front-line staff prioritize follow-up on delayed Items.
requirements.priority_rationale: Due-date ordering directly improves follow-up efficiency, although staff can temporarily prioritize Items using unsorted results.

requirements.name: Transit Items With Holds
requirements.description: The system shall produce a periodic Report of Items in Transit that have an outstanding Hold. The Report shall identify the Item, its Transit status, the relevant destination Branch, and the outstanding Hold. Staff shall be able to use the Report to coordinate delivery of Items needed to fulfill Holds.
requirements.priority_rationale: Monitoring held Items in Transit supports timely service and coordination, but it is narrower than the core Transit monitoring Report.

requirements.name: Uncataloged Item Inventory
requirements.description: The system shall represent, locate, and manage uncataloged Items as inventory before their Bibliographic Records are completed. Staff shall be able to record uncataloged shipments or Items, account for them, and include them in applicable operational Reports without requiring completed Bibliographic Records. Acceptance shall verify inventory control for materials such as paperbacks and children's board books throughout the uncataloged period.
requirements.priority_rationale: Tracking uncataloged Items is essential for accountability and daily management before cataloging is complete.

requirements.name: Report Uncataloged Item Use
requirements.description: The system shall record and Report how uncataloged Items are used before full cataloging. Reports shall support applicable usage and Circulation measures for individual uncataloged Items or relevant groups, including non-cataloged in-house use counts by month. Acceptance shall verify that staff can retrieve these usage measures independently of completed Bibliographic Records.
requirements.priority_rationale: Usage analysis is explicitly requested to evaluate uncataloged material, but it is secondary to basic inventory control.

requirements.name: Report Cataloged In-House Use
requirements.description: The system shall record and Report in-house use counts for cataloged Items. Staff shall be able to retrieve these counts to assess physical Item use within Branch facilities. Acceptance requires that a Report can distinguish cataloged in-house use and present the corresponding counts.
requirements.priority_rationale: This is a valid usage-reporting need but is less central to uncataloged material and is requested by only one candidate.

requirements.name: At-A-Glance Capacity Decisions
requirements.description: The system shall present capacity information so staff can understand the status of Branches quickly when deciding where to allocate resources or move Items. The presentation shall expose the key capacity indicators without requiring users to inspect multiple separate views. A representative user shall be able to identify the relevant Branch status from the overview during normal operational use.
requirements.priority_rationale: Rapid interpretation is important for daily operational decisions, although detailed Reports remain a temporary alternative.

requirements.name: Large Location Usability
requirements.description: The system shall keep the capacity interface usable and comprehensible when a System contains a large number of Branches. It shall provide mechanisms such as grouping, filtering, or aggregation to prevent the overview from becoming excessively cluttered. The interface shall remain operable for a location count of at least 286 Branches.
requirements.priority_rationale: The stated large-location scenario can impair daily use and requires explicit usability safeguards, though it affects larger Systems most directly.

requirements.name: Outlier Identification Presentation
requirements.description: The system shall present Shelf Space comparison results in a visual or tabular form that makes outliers between space allocation and use easy to identify. The presentation shall preserve the underlying percentage values so users can verify why a result is an outlier. This capability shall apply to the selected genre, format, Branch, System, and date range.
requirements.priority_rationale: Quickly identifying space-versus-use mismatches supports the stated management purpose, while manual inspection remains possible.

requirements.name: Retain Deletion Audit Logs
requirements.description: The system shall retain deletion and denied-deletion audit logs for a period and in a manner suitable for applicable audit, legal, and data-retention requirements. Retained logs shall remain available as evidence of how deletion activities were handled. The retention behavior shall support libraries that must demonstrate compliance with their retention schedules.
requirements.priority_rationale: Preserving deletion evidence is necessary for legal and audit obligations explicitly identified by stakeholders.

requirements.name: Accessible User Interfaces
requirements.description: The system shall comply with applicable legal accessibility requirements, including Section 508 where applicable to the System. All reporting and other staff-facing interfaces, including the help system, shall support common assistive technologies such as screen readers and screen magnification software. Accessibility shall be verifiable through conformance evaluation and practical operation with technologies such as JAWS, NVDA, and ZoomText.
requirements.priority_rationale: Accessibility is described as mandatory and non-negotiable for the public institution, and multiple sources require assistive-technology support and compliance.

requirements.name: Protect Archived Financial Privacy
requirements.description: The system shall archive financial Transaction data in a form that protects Patron privacy while satisfying applicable legal and audit retention requirements. Archived data shall not retain personally identifiable information when that information is not required for compliance. The retained data shall remain useful for authorized financial and aggregate statistical reporting.
requirements.priority_rationale: Protecting Patron personally identifiable information during legally required retention is an explicit privacy and compliance obligation.

requirements.name: Update Payments Immediately
requirements.description: The system shall update the applicable financial records when a Patron payment is recorded. The updated payment, account balance, and related Reports shall become available without a material operational delay after the payment is accepted. This behavior shall apply to payments recorded at the front desk and equivalent payment interfaces.
requirements.priority_rationale: Immediate balance and payment visibility is necessary for reliable front-desk operations and accurate financial reporting.

requirements.name: Edit Financial Information
requirements.description: The system shall allow authorized staff to update financial information attached to Patron and Item records. The editing interface shall support routine corrections without requiring direct database manipulation. Changes shall preserve the resulting financial record for subsequent reporting and audit.
requirements.priority_rationale: Staff need efficient correction of financial information, although a controlled manual workaround may exist.

requirements.name: Consortium Scale Support
requirements.description: The system shall support operation across a large consortium with approximately 286 Branches, 17 million annual Circulation transactions, and processing of more than 900,000 Items per year. It shall maintain usable reporting and administrative operation at this scale. Acceptance shall include successful handling of the stated location, transaction, purchasing, and processing volumes.
requirements.priority_rationale: The stated consortium scale is essential for the target System to operate acceptably.

requirements.name: Ensure Transaction-Safe Updates
requirements.description: The system shall apply batch Item-location updates within transaction-safe operations that preserve database integrity. If an update fails, the system shall roll back the affected operation so that it does not leave a partially updated transfer. Acceptance shall include inducing an update failure and verifying that the affected Items retain a consistent pre-operation or fully committed state.
requirements.priority_rationale: Partial location updates could lose control of Items, so transaction safety is essential for every batch transfer.

requirements.name: Log Transfer Operations
requirements.description: The system shall record every transfer operation in an Audit Log. Each record shall include the initiating staff identity, the affected Items, source and destination locations, and the operation timestamp. Acceptance shall include retrieving a complete log entry after a transfer is initiated and completed.
requirements.priority_rationale: Transfer accountability and traceability are explicitly required for auditing and operational investigation.

requirements.name: Scale Large Transfer Updates
requirements.description: The system shall process large batch transfers efficiently, including collections containing millions of Items, without excessive database locking or unacceptable performance degradation. Processing shall support smaller batches or chunks when needed to limit lock duration. Acceptance shall include measuring a large transfer under representative load and verifying that processing completes without excessive locking or service disruption.
requirements.priority_rationale: The stated collection size and explicit locking concern make scalable transfer processing necessary for an acceptable system.

requirements.name: Anonymized Demographic Reporting
requirements.description: The system shall anonymize data used for demographic Reports and statistics so that the outputs do not expose personally identifiable information. Aggregation shall prevent a demographic result from directly identifying an individual Patron. Acceptance shall verify that demographic outputs omit or remove identifying Patron details.
requirements.priority_rationale: Protecting Patron privacy is explicitly required by multiple sources and is essential for acceptable demographic reporting.

requirements.name: Large Patron Dataset Performance
requirements.description: The system shall process inactive Patron Reports acceptably on large datasets, including an example scale of approximately 3.5 million Patron records. The implementation shall use appropriate query optimization, indexing, aggregation, or caching techniques. Performance testing shall demonstrate that the Report remains operationally usable at the target scale.
requirements.priority_rationale: The stated dataset scale can make the core inactive-Patron operation unusable without explicit performance engineering.

requirements.name: Background Inactivity Processing
requirements.description: The system shall execute the inactive Patron Report as a background process when its data volume or activity aggregation could affect interactive use. The system shall cache or otherwise retain completed results for retrieval without repeating the full calculation unnecessarily. Processing shall not block normal interactive System operations.
requirements.priority_rationale: The source identifies the query as potentially expensive, making background execution and result reuse important for operational performance.

requirements.name: Non Disruptive Reporting
requirements.description: The system shall allow searches and Reports to execute during open hours without materially disrupting protected production workflows. Reporting workloads shall be isolated or controlled so complex queries do not tie up shared resources or reduce normal responsiveness of the circulation client, OPAC, or other system functions. Acceptance testing shall demonstrate normal staff and Patron responsiveness while representative complex Reports are running.
requirements.priority_rationale: The sources consistently identify uninterrupted circulation-client and OPAC operation during open-hours reporting as essential.

requirements.name: Training Data Isolation
requirements.description: The system shall ensure that the training environment cannot put production data at risk. It shall provide data isolation, sanitized data, test data, or an equivalent control that prevents training activities from changing or exposing live operational data. Acceptance shall verify that staff can experiment in training without affecting production data.
requirements.priority_rationale: Preventing training activity from damaging or exposing production data is essential for safe operation.

requirements.name: Discoverable Reports Interface
requirements.description: The system shall provide a Reports interface with clear navigation, search, and discovery features. Staff shall be able to locate available Reports without relying on undocumented knowledge of the system. Usability evaluation shall verify that representative staff can find specified Reports using the provided interface.
requirements.priority_rationale: Staff explicitly report difficulty finding Reports, making discoverability important though a manual workaround may exist.

requirements.name: Real-Time Reporting Capability
requirements.description: The system shall support real-time or near-real-time Reports for selected operational use cases. Such Reports shall reflect live activity or changes within a defined, documented freshness interval. The interval shall be specified per applicable Report and verified using newly created or changed source data.
requirements.priority_rationale: Staff survey feedback requests current data for busy-period monitoring, although not every Report requires real-time freshness.

requirements.name: Report Performance Under Load
requirements.description: The system shall generate Reports within acceptable response times during peak operating hours. Performance targets shall be defined for representative Reports and tested under representative peak data and workload conditions. Report execution shall not remain excessively delayed solely because the System is busy.
requirements.priority_rationale: Peak-hour delays are a reported operational problem, but temporary scheduling or workload-management workarounds may exist.

requirements.name: Record Purge Audit Trail
requirements.description: The system shall record every purge action in an Audit Log. Each entry shall identify who performed the action, what records were purged, and when the action occurred. The recorded information shall support accountability and investigation of purge operations.
requirements.priority_rationale: Auditable deletion accountability is explicitly required for all purge actions and supports safe administration.

requirements.name: Accurate Reliable Report Output
requirements.description: The system shall produce Report output that is accurate and reliable for stakeholder decision making. Report output shall be tested against appropriate source data and expected results before it is accepted for operational use. Test evidence shall demonstrate that the Report produces consistent results for defined test cases.
requirements.priority_rationale: Stakeholders must be able to trust Reports used for decisions, making output quality essential.

requirements.name: Visible Report Criteria
requirements.description: The system shall present the selection criteria applied to a Report clearly in the reporting interface. Users shall be able to identify the filters and parameters before executing the Report. The displayed criteria shall correspond to the criteria used for the generated results.
requirements.priority_rationale: Clear criteria visibility reduces reporting errors and is directly requested as a usability need.

requirements.name: Asynchronous Report Processing
requirements.description: The system shall place long-running, complex, and scheduled Report requests in the Report Queue for background execution. Queue processing shall continue during open hours without blocking interactive use or materially slowing the Circulation client and other production workflows. Acceptance shall verify that a queued Report executes asynchronously, that queue status is maintained, and that representative interactive operations remain available during execution.
